meaningEn: key point of the task; focus of the assignment

sentences.hanzi: 开始之前，老师先把这次作业重点讲清楚了。
sentences.pinyin: kai1 shi3 zhi1 qian2, lao3 shi1 xian1 ba3 zhe4 ci4 zuo4 ye4 zhong4 dian3 jiang3 qing1 chu3 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 시작하기 전에 선생님은 이번 과제의 핵심 포인트를 먼저 분명히 설명했다.
sentences.meaningEn: Before starting, the teacher first explained the key points of this assignment clearly.

meaningEn: to make a judgment; to arrive at a judgment

sentences.hanzi: 信息还不够完整，很难马上做出判断来。
sentences.pinyin: xin4 xi1 hai2 bu4 gou4 wan2 zheng3, hen3 nan2 ma3 shang4 zuo4 chu1 pan4 duan4 lai2.
sentences.meaningKo: 정보가 아직 충분히 완전하지 않아서 바로 판단을 내리기 어렵다.
sentences.meaningEn: The information is still not complete enough, so it is hard to arrive at a judgment immediately.

meaningEn: internal coordination within the team

sentences.hanzi: 只要组内协调到位，很多问题都能提前解决。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zu3 nei4 xie2 tiao2 dao4 wei4, hen3 duo1 wen4 ti2 dou1 neng2 ti2 qian2 jie3 jue2.
sentences.meaningKo: 조 내부 조정만 제대로 이루어지면 많은 문제를 미리 해결할 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as internal coordination within the team is done well, many problems can be solved in advance.

meaningEn: to sit opposite

sentences.hanzi: 他一直坐在对面，安静地听我们讨论。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 yi4 zhi2 zuo4 zai4 dui4 mian4, an1 jing4 di5 ting1 wo3 men5 tao3 lun4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 계속 맞은편에 앉아 우리가 토론하는 것을 조용히 듣고 있었다.
sentences.meaningEn: He sat opposite us the whole time, quietly listening to our discussion.

meaningEn: composition technique

sentences.hanzi: 这本书对提高作曲技巧很有帮助。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ben3 shu1 dui4 ti2 gao1 zuo4 qu3 ji4 qiao3 hen3 you3 bang1 zhu4.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 책은 작곡 기법을 높이는 데 큰 도움이 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: This book is very helpful for improving composition technique.

meaningEn: to act decisively and neatly

sentences.hanzi: 她做事干脆，从不拖泥带水。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 gan4 cui4, cong2 bu4 tuo1 ni2 dai4 shui3.
sentences.meaningKo: 그녀는 일 처리가 시원시원해서 질질 끄는 법이 없다.
sentences.meaningEn: She acts decisively and neatly, and never drags things out.

meaningEn: scope of the assignment; work scope

sentences.hanzi: 老师已经提前说明了这次作业范围。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 shi1 yi3 jing1 ti2 qian2 shuo1 ming2 le5 zhe4 ci4 zuo4 ye4 fan4 wei2.
sentences.meaningKo: 선생님은 이번 과제 범위를 이미 미리 설명했다.
sentences.meaningEn: The teacher has already explained the scope of this assignment in advance.

meaningEn: to sit in a daze looking out the window

sentences.hanzi: 他坐着发呆看窗外，好像在想很远的事情。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 zhe5 fa1 dai1 kan4 chuang1 wai4, hao3 xiang4 zai4 xiang3 hen3 yuan3 de5 shi4 qing2.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 멍하니 앉아 창밖을 보며 아주 먼 일을 생각하는 것 같았다.
sentences.meaningEn: He sat in a daze looking out the window, as if thinking about something far away.

meaningEn: team members split up and act separately

sentences.hanzi: 计划确定后，组员立刻分头行动。
sentences.pinyin: ji4 hua4 que4 ding4 hou4, zu3 yuan2 li4 ke4 fen1 tou2 xing2 dong4.
sentences.meaningKo: 계획이 확정되자 조원들은 즉시 나뉘어 행동했다.
sentences.meaningEn: After the plan was finalized, the team members immediately split up and acted separately.

meaningEn: to handle things prudently and properly

sentences.hanzi: 他做事稳妥，所以大家都愿意听他的意见。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 wen3 tuo3, suo3 yi3 da4 jia1 dou1 yuan4 yi4 ting1 ta1 de5 yi4 jian4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 일 처리가 신중하고 안정적이어서 모두가 그의 의견을 기꺼이 듣는다.
sentences.meaningEn: He handles things prudently, so everyone is willing to listen to his opinions.

meaningEn: answering standard; answer format rules

sentences.hanzi: 考试前，老师特意强调了作答规范。
sentences.pinyin: kao3 shi4 qian2, lao3 shi1 te4 yi4 qiang2 diao4 le5 zuo4 da2 gui1 fan4.
sentences.meaningKo: 시험 전에 선생님은 답안 작성 규범을 특별히 강조했다.
sentences.meaningEn: Before the exam, the teacher specifically emphasized the answering standards.

meaningEn: materials for composition; musical source material

sentences.hanzi: 生活中的很多细节都可以成为作曲素材。
sentences.pinyin: sheng1 huo2 zhong1 de5 hen3 duo1 xi4 jie2 dou1 ke3 yi3 cheng2 wei2 zuo4 qu3 su4 cai2.
sentences.meaningKo: 생활 속의 많은 세부는 모두 작곡 소재가 될 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: Many details in life can become materials for composition.

meaningEn: to sit in the front row and listen to the lecture

sentences.hanzi: 她总喜欢坐在前排听讲，记笔记也更方便。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zong3 xi3 huan1 zuo4 zai4 qian2 pai2 ting1 jiang3, ji4 bi3 ji4 ye3 geng4 fang1 bian4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그녀는 늘 앞줄에 앉아 설명을 듣는 것을 좋아하고 필기하기도 더 편하다.
sentences.meaningEn: She always likes to sit in the front row and listen to the lecture, and it is also more convenient for taking notes.

meaningEn: the group leader makes a summary

sentences.hanzi: 讨论结束以后，由组长做最后总结。
sentences.pinyin: tao3 lun4 jie2 shu4 yi3 hou4, you2 zu3 zhang3 zuo4 zui4 hou4 zong3 jie2.
sentences.meaningKo: 토론이 끝난 뒤 조장이 마지막 총정리를 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: After the discussion ends, the group leader gives the final summary.

meaningEn: to be efficient in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 他做事有效率，所以常常能提前完成任务。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 you3 xiao4 lv4, suo3 yi3 chang2 chang2 neng2 ti2 qian2 wan2 cheng2 ren4 wu5.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 일을 효율적으로 해서 자주 임무를 미리 끝낼 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: He is efficient in doing things, so he can often finish tasks ahead of time.

meaningEn: workflow linkage; handoff/connection between tasks

sentences.hanzi: 只要前后作业衔接顺畅，整体效率就会提升。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 qian2 hou4 zuo4 ye4 xian2 jie1 shun4 chang4, zheng3 ti3 xiao4 lv4 jiu4 hui4 ti2 sheng1.
sentences.meaningKo: 앞뒤 작업 연계만 원활하면 전체 효율이 올라간다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the linkage between tasks is smooth, overall efficiency will improve.

meaningEn: to sit at the doorway

sentences.hanzi: 老人常常坐在门口晒太阳。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 ren2 chang2 chang2 zuo4 zai4 men2 kou3 shai4 tai4 yang2.
sentences.meaningKo: 노인은 자주 문가에 앉아 햇볕을 쬔다.
sentences.meaningEn: The old man often sits at the doorway enjoying the sunshine.

meaningEn: team members speak in turn

sentences.hanzi: 会议上，组员轮流发言，补充了不少细节。
sentences.pinyin: hui4 yi4 shang4, zu3 yuan2 lun2 liu2 fa1 yan2, bu3 chong1 le5 bu4 shao3 xi4 jie2.
sentences.meaningKo: 회의에서 조원들은 돌아가며 발언하며 적잖은 세부를 보충했다.
sentences.meaningEn: At the meeting, the team members spoke in turn and added many details.

meaningEn: to react; to show a response

sentences.hanzi: 他愣了一下，随后才慢慢做出反应来。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 leng4 le5 yi2 xia4, sui2 hou4 cai2 man4 man4 zuo4 chu1 fan3 ying4 lai2.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 잠깐 멍해졌다가 그 뒤에야 천천히 반응을 보였다.
sentences.meaningEn: He froze for a moment, and only afterward did he slowly react.

meaningEn: composition process

sentences.hanzi: 整个作曲过程比想象中更花时间。
sentences.pinyin: zheng3 ge4 zuo4 qu3 guo4 cheng2 bi3 xiang3 xiang4 zhong1 geng4 hua1 shi2 jian1.
sentences.meaningKo: 전체 작곡 과정은 생각보다 더 많은 시간이 들었다.
sentences.meaningEn: The entire composition process took more time than expected.

meaningEn: to sit and do homework

sentences.hanzi: 他一回家就安安静静地坐着写作业。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 yi2 hui2 jia1 jiu4 an1 an1 jing4 jing4 di5 zuo4 zhe5 xie3 zuo4 ye4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 집에 돌아오자마자 조용히 앉아서 숙제를 했다.
sentences.meaningEn: As soon as he got home, he sat quietly and did his homework.

meaningEn: temporary arrangement by the group leader

sentences.hanzi: 有些变动是组长临时安排的，大家注意调整。
sentences.pinyin: you3 xie1 bian4 dong4 shi4 zu3 zhang3 lin2 shi2 an1 pai2 de5, da4 jia1 zhu4 yi4 tiao2 zheng3.
sentences.meaningKo: 일부 변동은 조장의 임시 배치이니 모두 조정에 유의해라.
sentences.meaningEn: Some changes were temporary arrangements made by the group leader, so everyone should adjust accordingly.

meaningEn: not impatient in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 他做事不急躁，所以越是复杂的任务越能处理好。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 bu4 ji2 zao4, suo3 yi3 yue4 shi4 fu4 za2 de5 ren4 wu5 yue4 neng2 chu3 li3 hao3.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 일할 때 조급해하지 않아서 복잡한 임무일수록 더 잘 처리할 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: He is not impatient in doing things, so the more complex the task is, the better he can handle it.

meaningEn: details of the work; assignment details

sentences.hanzi: 别忽略作业细节，很多问题都出在这些地方。
sentences.pinyin: bie2 hu1 lue4 zuo4 ye4 xi4 jie2, hen3 duo1 wen4 ti2 dou1 chu1 zai4 zhe4 xie1 di4 fang1.
sentences.meaningKo: 작업 세부 사항을 소홀히 하지 마라. 많은 문제는 이런 곳에서 생긴다.
sentences.meaningEn: Do not overlook the details of the work; many problems arise in exactly these places.

meaningEn: to sit here and wait

sentences.hanzi: 你先坐在这里等，我去把资料拿过来。
sentences.pinyin: ni3 xian1 zuo4 zai4 zhe4 li3 deng3, wo3 qu4 ba3 zi1 liao4 na2 guo4 lai2.
sentences.meaningKo: 너는 먼저 여기 앉아서 기다려라. 내가 자료를 가져오겠다.
sentences.meaningEn: Sit here and wait first; I will go get the materials.

meaningEn: team members cooperate in tacit understanding

sentences.hanzi: 组员配合默契，很多工作都推进得特别顺利。
sentences.pinyin: zu3 yuan2 pei4 he2 mo4 qi4, hen3 duo1 gong1 zuo4 dou1 tui1 jin4 de5 te4 bie2 shun4 li4.
sentences.meaningKo: 조원들의 호흡이 잘 맞아서 많은 일이 특히 순조롭게 진행되었다.
sentences.meaningEn: The team members cooperated with great tacit understanding, so much of the work progressed especially smoothly.

meaningEn: to put in effort; to make an effort

sentences.hanzi: 只要肯做出努力来，事情总会慢慢变好。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 ken3 zuo4 chu1 nu3 li4 lai2, shi4 qing2 zong3 hui4 man4 man4 bian4 hao3.
sentences.meaningKo: 기꺼이 노력을 기울이기만 하면 일은 결국 조금씩 나아진다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as one is willing to put in effort, things will gradually get better.

meaningEn: composition practice

sentences.hanzi: 每天坚持做一点作曲练习，进步会更明显。
sentences.pinyin: mei3 tian1 jian1 chi2 zuo4 yi4 dian3 zuo4 qu3 lian4 xi2, jin4 bu4 hui4 geng4 ming2 xian3.
sentences.meaningKo: 매일 조금씩이라도 작곡 연습을 꾸준히 하면 발전이 더 뚜렷해진다.
sentences.meaningEn: If you persist in doing a little composition practice every day, your progress will be more obvious.

meaningEn: to sit and attend class

sentences.hanzi: 他整节课都安安静静地坐着听课。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zheng3 jie2 ke4 dou1 an1 an1 jing4 jing4 di5 zuo4 zhe5 ting1 ke4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 수업 내내 조용히 앉아서 수업을 들었다.
sentences.meaningEn: He sat quietly and attended class throughout the whole lesson.

meaningEn: the group leader assigns tasks

sentences.hanzi: 组长刚布置完任务，大家就开始行动了。
sentences.pinyin: zu3 zhang3 gang1 bu4 zhi4 wan2 ren4 wu5, da4 jia1 jiu4 kai1 shi3 xing2 dong4 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 조장이 막 임무를 배치하자마자 모두가 행동을 시작했다.
sentences.meaningEn: As soon as the group leader finished assigning tasks, everyone started taking action.

meaningEn: work progress; progress of the assignment

sentences.hanzi: 请大家在会议上简单汇报一下各自的作业进展。
sentences.pinyin: qing3 da4 jia1 zai4 hui4 yi4 shang4 jian3 dan1 hui4 bao4 yi2 xia4 ge4 zi4 de5 zuo4 ye4 jin4 zhan3.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두 회의에서 각자의 작업 진척을 간단히 보고해 주세요.
sentences.meaningEn: Please briefly report your own work progress at the meeting.

meaningEn: before making a decision

sentences.hanzi: 做出决定前，最好先把各种情况都考虑清楚。
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 chu1 jue2 ding4 qian2, zui4 hao3 xian1 ba3 ge4 zhong3 qing2 kuang4 dou1 kao3 lv4 qing1 chu3.
sentences.meaningKo: 결정을 내리기 전에 여러 상황을 먼저 분명히 고려해 보는 것이 좋다.
sentences.meaningEn: Before making a decision, it is best to think through all the different circumstances clearly first.

meaningEn: team members arrive at the venue

sentences.hanzi: 等所有组员到场以后，我们再开始说明流程。
sentences.pinyin: deng3 suo3 you3 zu3 yuan2 dao4 chang3 yi3 hou4, wo3 men5 zai4 kai1 shi3 shuo1 ming2 liu2 cheng2.
sentences.meaningKo: 모든 조원이 현장에 도착한 뒤에야 우리는 절차 설명을 시작할 것이다.
sentences.meaningEn: After all team members have arrived at the venue, we will begin explaining the process.

meaningEn: to sit in the corner

sentences.hanzi: 他喜欢一个人坐在角落里安静地看书。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xi3 huan1 yi2 ge4 ren2 zuo4 zai4 jiao3 luo4 li3 an1 jing4 di5 kan4 shu1.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 혼자 구석에 앉아 조용히 책 읽는 것을 좋아한다.
sentences.meaningEn: He likes to sit alone in the corner and read quietly.

meaningEn: composition concept; compositional conception

sentences.hanzi: 这首曲子的作曲构思很新颖，让人一听就记住了。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shou3 qu3 zi5 de5 zuo4 qu3 gou4 si1 hen3 xin1 ying3, rang4 ren2 yi4 ting1 jiu4 ji4 zhu4 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 곡의 작곡 구상은 매우 참신해서 한 번 들으면 바로 기억에 남는다.
sentences.meaningEn: The compositional concept of this piece is very original, making it memorable after just one listen.

meaningEn: to value efficiency in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 现在时间紧，大家做事要讲效率。
sentences.pinyin: xian4 zai4 shi2 jian1 jin3, da4 jia1 zuo4 shi4 yao4 jiang3 xiao4 lv4.
sentences.meaningKo: 지금은 시간이 촉박하니 모두 일을 할 때 효율을 중시해야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: Time is tight now, so everyone needs to value efficiency in doing things.

meaningEn: presentation of work results

sentences.hanzi: 下周我们要进行一次作业成果展示。
sentences.pinyin: xia4 zhou1 wo3 men5 yao4 jin4 xing2 yi2 ci4 zuo4 ye4 cheng2 guo3 zhan3 shi4.
sentences.meaningKo: 다음 주에 우리는 한 차례 작업 성과 발표를 진행할 것이다.
sentences.meaningEn: Next week we will hold a presentation of the work results.

meaningEn: to sit and wait for notification

sentences.hanzi: 与其坐着等通知，不如先把能做的准备做好。
sentences.pinyin: yu3 qi2 zuo4 zhe5 deng3 tong1 zhi1, bu4 ru2 xian1 ba3 neng2 zuo4 de5 zhun3 bei4 zuo4 hao3.
sentences.meaningKo: 앉아서 통보를 기다리기보다는 먼저 할 수 있는 준비를 해 두는 편이 낫다.
sentences.meaningEn: Rather than sitting and waiting for notification, it is better to first complete the preparations you can make.

meaningEn: the group leader puts forward an opinion

sentences.hanzi: 讨论中，组长提出了几个很关键的意见。
sentences.pinyin: tao3 lun4 zhong1, zu3 zhang3 ti2 chu1 le5 ji3 ge4 hen3 guan1 jian4 de5 yi4 jian4.
sentences.meaningKo: 토론 중에 조장은 몇 가지 매우 중요한 의견을 제시했다.
sentences.meaningEn: During the discussion, the group leader put forward several very important opinions.

meaningEn: to act with a sense of proportion; to know the proper limits
meaningKo: 일할 때 정도를 알다; 분수를 지키다

sentences.hanzi: 他做事有分寸，所以很少让人觉得为难。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 you3 fen4 cun4, suo3 yi3 hen3 shao3 rang4 ren2 jue2 de5 wei2 nan2.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 일을 할 때 정도를 알아서 남을 난처하게 만드는 일이 거의 없다.
sentences.meaningEn: He acts with a sense of proportion, so he rarely makes others feel uncomfortable.

meaningEn: steps for answering

sentences.hanzi: 老师把这道题的作答步骤写在黑板上了。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 shi1 ba3 zhe4 dao4 ti2 de5 zuo4 da2 bu4 zhou4 xie3 zai4 hei1 ban3 shang4 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 선생님은 이 문제의 답안 작성 단계를 칠판에 적어 두었다.
sentences.meaningEn: The teacher wrote the answering steps for this question on the blackboard.

meaningEn: method of composition

sentences.hanzi: 老师介绍了几种常见的作曲方法。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 shi1 jie4 shao4 le5 ji3 zhong3 chang2 jian4 de5 zuo4 qu3 fang1 fa3.
sentences.meaningKo: 선생님은 몇 가지 흔한 작곡 방법을 소개했다.
sentences.meaningEn: The teacher introduced several common methods of composition.

meaningEn: to sit there waiting for someone

sentences.hanzi: 我刚到的时候，他已经坐在那里等人了。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 gang1 dao4 de5 shi2 hou4, ta1 yi3 jing1 zuo4 zai4 na4 li3 deng3 ren2 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 내가 막 도착했을 때 그는 이미 거기 앉아 누군가를 기다리고 있었다.
sentences.meaningEn: When I had just arrived, he was already sitting there waiting for someone.

meaningEn: the group leader is responsible for notification

sentences.hanzi: 具体时间由组长负责通知大家。
sentences.pinyin: ju4 ti3 shi2 jian1 you2 zu3 zhang3 fu4 ze2 tong1 zhi1 da4 jia1.
sentences.meaningKo: 구체적인 시간은 조장이 모두에게 공지하는 책임을 진다.
sentences.meaningEn: The group leader is responsible for notifying everyone of the specific time.

meaningEn: to do things in a planned way

sentences.hanzi: 她做事有计划，所以很少临时手忙脚乱。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 you3 ji4 hua4, suo3 yi3 hen3 shao3 lin2 shi2 shou3 mang2 jiao3 luan4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그녀는 일을 계획적으로 해서 갑자기 허둥대는 일이 거의 없다.
sentences.meaningEn: She does things in a planned way, so she is rarely flustered at the last minute.

meaningEn: workflow chart; process flow diagram

sentences.hanzi: 把作业流程图贴出来，大家看起来会更直观。
sentences.pinyin: ba3 zuo4 ye4 liu2 cheng2 tu2 tie1 chu1 lai2, da4 jia1 kan4 qi3 lai2 hui4 geng4 zhi2 guan1.
sentences.meaningKo: 작업 흐름도를 붙여 두면 모두가 볼 때 더 직관적이다.
sentences.meaningEn: If the workflow chart is posted, it will be more intuitive for everyone to see.

meaningEn: to sit on one side and watch

sentences.hanzi: 你先坐在一旁看，熟悉以后再动手。
sentences.pinyin: ni3 xian1 zuo4 zai4 yi4 pang2 kan4, shu2 xi1 yi3 hou4 zai4 dong4 shou3.
sentences.meaningKo: 너는 먼저 한쪽에 앉아 지켜보다가 익숙해진 뒤에 손을 대라.
sentences.meaningEn: Sit on one side and watch first, then start doing it after you become familiar with it.

meaningEn: team members put forward suggestions

sentences.hanzi: 不少组员都主动提出了改进建议。
sentences.pinyin: bu4 shao3 zu3 yuan2 dou1 zhu3 dong4 ti2 chu1 le5 gai3 jin4 jian4 yi4.
sentences.meaningKo: 적잖은 조원들이 자발적으로 개선 건의를 내놓았다.
sentences.meaningEn: Quite a few team members proactively put forward suggestions for improvement.

meaningEn: after making a choice

sentences.hanzi: 做出选择后，就要对自己的决定负责。
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 chu1 xuan3 ze2 hou4, jiu4 yao4 dui4 zi4 ji3 de5 jue2 ding4 fu4 ze2.
sentences.meaningKo: 선택을 한 뒤에는 자신의 결정에 책임을 져야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: After making a choice, one must take responsibility for one’s own decision.

meaningEn: distinctive in compositional style

sentences.hanzi: 他的作曲风格鲜明，一听就能认出来。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 de5 zuo4 qu3 feng1 ge2 xian1 ming2, yi4 ting1 jiu4 neng2 ren4 chu1 lai2.
sentences.meaningKo: 그의 작곡 스타일은 매우 선명해서 한 번 들으면 바로 알아챌 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: His compositional style is very distinctive, and it can be recognized after just one listen.

meaningEn: to sit there blankly

sentences.hanzi: 别老坐在那里发愣，先把该做的事做完。
sentences.pinyin: bie2 lao3 zuo4 zai4 na4 li3 fa1 leng4, xian1 ba3 gai1 zuo4 de5 shi4 zuo4 wan2.
sentences.meaningKo: 계속 거기 멍하니 앉아 있지 말고 먼저 해야 할 일을 끝내라.
sentences.meaningEn: Do not keep sitting there blankly; first finish what you are supposed to do.

meaningEn: the group leader organizes a discussion

sentences.hanzi: 遇到争议时，组长会先组织讨论。
sentences.pinyin: yu4 dao4 zheng1 yi4 shi2, zu3 zhang3 hui4 xian1 zu3 zhi1 tao3 lun4.
sentences.meaningKo: 논쟁이 생기면 조장은 먼저 토론을 조직한다.
sentences.meaningEn: When disputes arise, the group leader first organizes a discussion.

meaningEn: to value method in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 做事要讲方法，光靠蛮干往往不够。
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 shi4 yao4 jiang3 fang1 fa3, guang1 kao4 man2 gan4 wang3 wang3 bu4 gou4.
sentences.meaningKo: 일할 때는 방법을 중시해야지 무작정 힘으로만 해서는 대개 부족하다.
sentences.meaningEn: When doing things, one must value method; relying on brute effort alone is often not enough.

meaningEn: work report; assignment report

sentences.hanzi: 请在明天下午之前提交作业报告。
sentences.pinyin: qing3 zai4 ming2 tian1 xia4 wu3 zhi1 qian2 ti2 jiao1 zuo4 ye4 bao4 gao4.
sentences.meaningKo: 내일 오후 전까지 작업 보고서를 제출해 주세요.
sentences.meaningEn: Please submit the work report before tomorrow afternoon.

meaningEn: to work sitting down; to do office work seated

sentences.hanzi: 坐着办公太久也要记得起来活动。
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 zhe5 ban4 gong1 tai4 jiu3 ye3 yao4 ji4 de5 qi3 lai2 huo2 dong4.
sentences.meaningKo: 앉아서 너무 오래 일했다면 일어나 움직이는 것도 잊지 말아야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: If you work sitting down for too long, you should remember to get up and move around.

meaningEn: team members cooperate with each other

sentences.hanzi: 只要组员相互配合，任务就不会太难。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zu3 yuan2 xiang1 hu4 pei4 he2, ren4 wu5 jiu4 bu2 hui4 tai4 nan2.
sentences.meaningKo: 조원들이 서로 협력하기만 하면 임무가 그다지 어렵지 않다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the team members cooperate with each other, the task will not be too difficult.

meaningEn: to make a report

sentences.hanzi: 项目结束后，我们要及时做出汇报。
sentences.pinyin: xiang4 mu4 jie2 shu4 hou4, wo3 men5 yao4 ji2 shi2 zuo4 chu1 hui4 bao4.
sentences.meaningKo: 프로젝트가 끝난 뒤 우리는 제때 보고를 해야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: After the project ends, we need to make a report in a timely manner.

meaningEn: composition ability improves

sentences.hanzi: 坚持练习以后，他的作曲能力提高得很快。
sentences.pinyin: jian1 chi2 lian4 xi2 yi3 hou4, ta1 de5 zuo4 qu3 neng2 li4 ti2 gao1 de5 hen3 kuai4.
sentences.meaningKo: 꾸준히 연습한 뒤 그의 작곡 능력은 매우 빠르게 향상되었다.
sentences.meaningEn: After practicing consistently, his composition ability improved very quickly.

meaningEn: to sit and think

sentences.hanzi: 他一个人坐着思考了很久，才慢慢开口。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 yi2 ge4 ren2 zuo4 zhe5 si1 kao3 le5 hen3 jiu3, cai2 man4 man4 kai1 kou3.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 혼자 오래 앉아서 생각한 뒤에야 천천히 입을 열었다.
sentences.meaningEn: He sat and thought alone for a long time before finally speaking slowly.

meaningEn: the group leader arranges things in a unified way

sentences.hanzi: 接下来的流程由组长统一安排。
sentences.pinyin: jie1 xia4 lai2 de5 liu2 cheng2 you2 zu3 zhang3 tong3 yi1 an1 pai2.
sentences.meaningKo: 이후의 절차는 조장이 통일적으로 배치한다.
sentences.meaningEn: The following procedures will be arranged in a unified way by the group leader.

meaningEn: working method; method for doing the assignment

sentences.hanzi: 只要掌握了正确的作业方法，效率就会提高很多。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zhang3 wo4 le5 zheng4 que4 de5 zuo4 ye4 fang1 fa3, xiao4 lv4 jiu4 hui4 ti2 gao1 hen3 duo1.
sentences.meaningKo: 올바른 작업 방법만 익히면 효율이 훨씬 높아진다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as you master the correct working method, efficiency will improve a lot.

meaningEn: to make up one's mind; to arrive at a decision

sentences.hanzi: 大家讨论了很久，终于做出决定来了。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 tao3 lun4 le5 hen3 jiu3, zhong1 yu2 zuo4 chu1 jue2 ding4 lai2 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두가 오랫동안 토론한 끝에 마침내 결정을 내렸다.
sentences.meaningEn: After a long discussion, everyone finally arrived at a decision.

meaningEn: team members consult with each other; consultation among team members

sentences.hanzi: 有分歧的时候，先让组员协商一下。
sentences.pinyin: you3 fen1 qi2 de5 shi2 hou4, xian1 rang4 zu3 yuan2 xie2 shang1 yi2 xia4.
sentences.meaningKo: 의견 차이가 있을 때는 먼저 조원들이 한번 협의하게 해라.
sentences.meaningEn: When there are disagreements, let the team members consult with each other first.

meaningEn: to sit where one is; to remain seated in place

sentences.hanzi: 请大家坐在原地，不要随意走动。
sentences.pinyin: qing3 da4 jia1 zuo4 zai4 yuan2 di4, bu2 yao4 sui2 yi4 zou3 dong4.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두 제자리에 앉아 있고 함부로 돌아다니지 마세요.
sentences.meaningEn: Please remain seated where you are and do not walk around at will.

meaningEn: rich in compositional inspiration

sentences.hanzi: 他平时观察很细，所以作曲灵感一直很丰富。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 ping2 shi2 guan1 cha2 hen3 xi4, suo3 yi3 zuo4 qu3 ling2 gan3 yi4 zhi2 hen3 feng1 fu4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 평소 관찰을 매우 세밀하게 해서 작곡 영감이 늘 풍부하다.
sentences.meaningEn: He observes things very carefully in daily life, so his compositional inspiration is always rich.

meaningEn: to do things in an orderly and unhurried way

sentences.hanzi: 她做事有条不紊，再忙也不会乱。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 you3 tiao2 bu4 wen3, zai4 mang2 ye3 bu2 hui4 luan4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그녀는 일을 차분하고 질서 있게 해서 아무리 바빠도 흐트러지지 않는다.
sentences.meaningEn: She does things in an orderly way, and no matter how busy she gets, she never becomes chaotic.

meaningEn: the assignment requirements are clear

sentences.hanzi: 老师讲得很详细，所以这次作业要求很清楚。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 shi1 jiang3 de5 hen3 xiang2 xi4, suo3 yi3 zhe4 ci4 zuo4 ye4 yao1 qiu2 hen3 qing1 chu3.
sentences.meaningKo: 선생님이 아주 자세히 설명해서 이번 과제 요구 사항은 매우 분명하다.
sentences.meaningEn: The teacher explained it very thoroughly, so the requirements for this assignment are very clear.

meaningEn: to sit silently without speaking

sentences.hanzi: 他一直坐着不说话，好像还在想刚才的事。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 yi4 zhi2 zuo4 zhe5 bu4 shuo1 hua4, hao3 xiang4 hai2 zai4 xiang3 gang1 cai2 de5 shi4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 계속 앉아서 말하지 않고 방금 일을 아직도 생각하는 것 같았다.
sentences.meaningEn: He kept sitting silently without speaking, as if he were still thinking about what had just happened.

meaningEn: the group leader coordinates the work

sentences.hanzi: 遇到衔接问题时，通常由组长来协调工作。
sentences.pinyin: yu4 dao4 xian2 jie1 wen4 ti2 shi2, tong1 chang2 you2 zu3 zhang3 lai2 xie2 tiao2 gong1 zuo4.
sentences.meaningKo: 연계 문제가 생기면 보통 조장이 나서서 업무를 조정한다.
sentences.meaningEn: When coordination problems arise, the group leader usually steps in to coordinate the work.

meaningEn: to be thorough and considerate in doing things
meaningKo: 일을 할 때 두루 세심하게 고려하다

sentences.hanzi: 她做事考虑周到，所以常常能提前发现问题。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 kao3 lv4 zhou1 dao4, suo3 yi3 chang2 chang2 neng2 ti2 qian2 fa1 xian4 wen4 ti2.
sentences.meaningKo: 그녀는 일을 할 때 두루 세심하게 고려해서 자주 문제를 미리 발견할 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: She is thorough and considerate in doing things, so she can often spot problems in advance.

meaningEn: not enough time to answer

sentences.hanzi: 这部分题太多了，很多人都觉得作答时间不够。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 bu4 fen4 ti2 tai4 duo1 le5, hen3 duo1 ren2 dou1 jue2 de5 zuo4 da2 shi2 jian1 bu4 gou4.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 부분 문제는 너무 많아서 많은 사람들이 답안 작성 시간이 부족하다고 느낀다.
sentences.meaningEn: There are too many questions in this section, so many people feel that there is not enough time to answer.

meaningEn: practice piece for composition

sentences.hanzi: 老师让我们先写一首简单的作曲练习曲。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 shi1 rang4 wo3 men5 xian1 xie3 yi4 shou3 jian3 dan1 de5 zuo4 qu3 lian4 xi2 qu3.
sentences.meaningKo: 선생님은 우리에게 먼저 간단한 작곡 연습곡 한 곡을 쓰게 하셨다.
sentences.meaningEn: The teacher asked us to first write a simple practice piece for composition.

meaningEn: to sit and read materials

sentences.hanzi: 他下午一直坐着看资料，几乎没有休息。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xia4 wu3 yi4 zhi2 zuo4 zhe5 kan4 zi1 liao4, ji1 hu1 mei2 you3 xiu1 xi5.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 오후 내내 앉아서 자료를 보았고 거의 쉬지 않았다.
sentences.meaningEn: He sat reading materials all afternoon and hardly took a break.

meaningEn: the group leader allocates tasks

sentences.hanzi: 组长已经把任务分配好了，大家照着做就行。
sentences.pinyin: zu3 zhang3 yi3 jing1 ba3 ren4 wu5 fen1 pei4 hao3 le5, da4 jia1 zhao4 zhe5 zuo4 jiu4 xing2.
sentences.meaningKo: 조장이 이미 임무를 잘 분배해 두었으니 모두 그대로 하면 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: The group leader has already allocated the tasks, so everyone just needs to follow them.

meaningEn: to take responsibility in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 他做事有担当，所以大家都愿意信任他。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 you3 dan1 dang1, suo3 yi3 da4 jia1 dou1 yuan4 yi4 xin4 ren4 ta1.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 일할 때 책임감이 있어서 모두가 그를 기꺼이 신뢰한다.
sentences.meaningEn: He takes responsibility in doing things, so everyone is willing to trust him.

meaningEn: the work was completed quite well

sentences.hanzi: 这次大家配合得很好，作业完成得不错。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ci4 da4 jia1 pei4 he2 de5 hen3 hao3, zuo4 ye4 wan2 cheng2 de5 bu2 cuo4.
sentences.meaningKo: 이번에는 모두가 협력을 잘해서 작업이 꽤 잘 완료되었다.
sentences.meaningEn: This time everyone cooperated well, and the work was completed quite well.

meaningEn: to sit and wait for news to come

sentences.hanzi: 与其坐着等消息来，不如自己主动去确认。
sentences.pinyin: yu3 qi2 zuo4 zhe5 deng3 xiao1 xi5 lai2, bu4 ru2 zi4 ji3 zhu3 dong4 qu4 que4 ren4.
sentences.meaningKo: 앉아서 소식이 오기만 기다리기보다는 스스로 적극적으로 확인하러 가는 편이 낫다.
sentences.meaningEn: Rather than sitting and waiting for news to come, it is better to take the initiative to check yourself.

meaningEn: the group leader explains the situation

sentences.hanzi: 会议一开始，组长先说明了目前的情况。
sentences.pinyin: hui4 yi4 yi4 kai1 shi3, zu3 zhang3 xian1 shuo1 ming2 le5 mu4 qian2 de5 qing2 kuang4.
sentences.meaningKo: 회의가 시작되자 조장이 먼저 현재 상황을 설명했다.
sentences.meaningEn: At the beginning of the meeting, the group leader first explained the current situation.

meaningEn: to follow rules in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 在这里做事要讲规矩，不能想怎么来就怎么来。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 zhe4 li3 zuo4 shi4 yao4 jiang3 gui1 ju3, bu4 neng2 xiang3 zen3 me5 lai2 jiu4 zen3 me5 lai2.
sentences.meaningKo: 이곳에서 일할 때는 규칙을 지켜야 하며 마음대로 해서는 안 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: When doing things here, one must follow rules and cannot just do whatever one wants.

meaningEn: there is a lot of assignment content

sentences.hanzi: 这次作业内容多，大家最好早点开始。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ci4 zuo4 ye4 nei4 rong2 duo1, da4 jia1 zui4 hao3 zao3 dian3 kai1 shi3.
sentences.meaningKo: 이번 과제는 내용이 많으니 모두가 좀 더 일찍 시작하는 편이 좋다.
sentences.meaningEn: This assignment contains a lot of content, so everyone had better start a bit earlier.

meaningEn: to sit indoors; to sit inside the room

sentences.hanzi: 外面太冷了，大家还是坐在屋里聊吧。
sentences.pinyin: wai4 mian4 tai4 leng3 le5, da4 jia1 hai2 shi4 zuo4 zai4 wu1 li3 liao2 ba5.
sentences.meaningKo: 밖이 너무 추우니 모두 방 안에 앉아 이야기하는 편이 낫다.
sentences.meaningEn: It is too cold outside, so everyone had better sit indoors and chat.

meaningEn: the group leader asks for opinions

sentences.hanzi: 在做决定之前，组长先征求了大家的意见。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 zuo4 jue2 ding4 zhi1 qian2, zu3 zhang3 xian1 zheng1 qiu2 le5 da4 jia1 de5 yi4 jian4.
sentences.meaningKo: 결정을 내리기 전에 조장은 먼저 모두의 의견을 구했다.
sentences.meaningEn: Before making a decision, the group leader first asked for everyone’s opinions.

meaningEn: not flustered in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 他做事不慌，所以关键时刻特别稳。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 bu4 huang1, suo3 yi3 guan1 jian4 shi2 ke4 te4 bie2 wen3.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 일할 때 허둥대지 않아서 중요한 순간에 특히 침착하다.
sentences.meaningEn: He is not flustered in doing things, so he is especially steady at critical moments.

meaningEn: answer result; result of answering

sentences.hanzi: 系统会自动记录每个人的作答结果。
sentences.pinyin: xi4 tong3 hui4 zi4 dong4 ji4 lu4 mei3 ge4 ren2 de5 zuo4 da2 jie2 guo3.
sentences.meaningKo: 시스템은 각 사람의 답안 결과를 자동으로 기록한다.
sentences.meaningEn: The system will automatically record each person’s answer result.

meaningEn: compositional style takes shape

sentences.hanzi: 经过多年积累，他的作曲风格已经逐渐形成。
sentences.pinyin: jing1 guo4 duo1 nian2 ji1 lei3, ta1 de5 zuo4 qu3 feng1 ge2 yi3 jing1 zhu2 jian4 xing2 cheng2.
sentences.meaningKo: 여러 해의 축적을 거쳐 그의 작곡 스타일은 이미 점차 형성되었다.
sentences.meaningEn: After many years of accumulation, his compositional style has gradually taken shape.

meaningEn: to sit and read a book

sentences.hanzi: 他喜欢一个人坐着看书，不爱被人打扰。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xi3 huan1 yi2 ge4 ren2 zuo4 zhe5 kan4 shu1, bu2 ai4 bei4 ren2 da3 rao3.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 혼자 앉아서 책 읽는 것을 좋아하고 남에게 방해받는 것을 좋아하지 않는다.
sentences.meaningEn: He likes to sit and read by himself and does not like being disturbed.

meaningEn: the group leader is responsible for communication

sentences.hanzi: 对外联系这件事，由组长负责沟通。
sentences.pinyin: dui4 wai4 lian2 xi4 zhe4 jian4 shi4, you2 zu3 zhang3 fu4 ze2 gou1 tong1.
sentences.meaningKo: 대외 연락은 조장이 소통을 책임진다.
sentences.meaningEn: As for external contact, the group leader is responsible for communication.

meaningEn: to do things step by step

sentences.hanzi: 做事有步骤，效率和质量都会更稳定。
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 shi4 you3 bu4 zhou4, xiao4 lv4 he2 zhi4 liang4 dou1 hui4 geng4 wen3 ding4.
sentences.meaningKo: 일을 단계적으로 하면 효율과 품질이 모두 더 안정적이 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: If you do things step by step, both efficiency and quality will become more stable.

meaningEn: work materials; assignment materials

sentences.hanzi: 作业资料已经整理好了，大家可以直接查看。
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 ye4 zi1 liao4 yi3 jing1 zheng3 li3 hao3 le5, da4 jia1 ke3 yi3 zhi2 jie1 cha2 kan4.
sentences.meaningKo: 작업 자료는 이미 정리되어 있으니 모두 바로 확인할 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: The work materials have already been organized, so everyone can check them directly.

meaningEn: to sit there thinking about a problem

sentences.hanzi: 他坐在那里想问题，半天都没有开口。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 zai4 na4 li3 xiang3 wen4 ti2, ban4 tian1 dou1 mei2 you3 kai1 kou3.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 거기 앉아 문제를 생각하느라 한참 동안 입을 열지 않았다.
sentences.meaningEn: He sat there thinking about the problem and did not speak for a long time.

meaningEn: standardization of operations; to standardize work procedures

sentences.hanzi: 推进作业标准化以后，整体效率明显提高了。
sentences.pinyin: tui1 jin4 zuo4 ye4 biao1 zhun3 hua4 yi3 hou4, zheng3 ti3 xiao4 lv4 ming2 xian3 ti2 gao1 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 작업 표준화를 추진한 뒤 전체 효율이 눈에 띄게 높아졌다.
sentences.meaningEn: After promoting the standardization of operations, overall efficiency improved noticeably.

meaningEn: to reflect on oneself; to carry out self-examination

sentences.hanzi: 出现问题以后，大家都应该认真做出反省。
sentences.pinyin: chu1 xian4 wen4 ti2 yi3 hou4, da4 jia1 dou1 ying1 gai1 ren4 zhen1 zuo4 chu1 fan3 xing3.
sentences.meaningKo: 문제가 생긴 뒤에는 모두가 진지하게 반성해야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: After problems arise, everyone should seriously reflect on themselves.

meaningEn: team members have different opinions

sentences.hanzi: 组员意见不同的时候，先别急着下结论。
sentences.pinyin: zu3 yuan2 yi4 jian4 bu4 tong2 de5 shi2 hou4, xian1 bie2 ji2 zhe5 xia4 jie2 lun4.
sentences.meaningKo: 조원들의 의견이 다를 때는 먼저 서둘러 결론을 내리지 마라.
sentences.meaningEn: When team members have different opinions, do not rush to a conclusion first.

meaningEn: to sit below the stage; to sit in the audience

sentences.hanzi: 他坐在台下，认真听完了整场报告。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 zai4 tai2 xia4, ren4 zhen1 ting1 wan2 le5 zheng3 chang3 bao4 gao4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 무대 아래에 앉아 전체 보고를 진지하게 끝까지 들었다.
sentences.meaningEn: He sat in the audience and listened carefully to the entire report.

meaningEn: composition level improves

sentences.hanzi: 坚持练习一段时间后，他的作曲水平提高得很快。
sentences.pinyin: jian1 chi2 lian4 xi2 yi2 duan4 shi2 jian1 hou4, ta1 de5 zuo4 qu3 shui3 ping2 ti2 gao1 de5 hen3 kuai4.
sentences.meaningKo: 한동안 꾸준히 연습한 뒤 그의 작곡 수준은 매우 빠르게 향상되었다.
sentences.meaningEn: After practicing consistently for a period of time, his composition level improved very quickly.

meaningEn: to be punctual in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 他做事守时，所以大家和他合作都很放心。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 shou3 shi2, suo3 yi3 da4 jia1 he2 ta1 he2 zuo4 dou1 hen3 fang4 xin1.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 일할 때 시간을 잘 지켜서 모두가 그와 협력할 때 매우 안심한다.
sentences.meaningEn: He is punctual in doing things, so everyone feels at ease working with him.

meaningEn: the assignment content is clear

sentences.hanzi: 只要作业内容明确，推进起来就会顺利很多。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 ye4 nei4 rong2 ming2 que4, tui1 jin4 qi3 lai2 jiu4 hui4 shun4 li4 hen3 duo1.
sentences.meaningKo: 과제 내용이 명확하기만 하면 추진이 훨씬 순조로워진다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the assignment content is clear, it will proceed much more smoothly.

meaningEn: to sit and hold a meeting

sentences.hanzi: 大家先坐着开会，把重点问题谈清楚。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 xian1 zuo4 zhe5 kai1 hui4, ba3 zhong4 dian3 wen4 ti2 tan2 qing1 chu3.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두 먼저 앉아서 회의를 하며 핵심 문제를 분명히 이야기하자.
sentences.meaningEn: Let everyone sit down and hold a meeting first, and talk the key issues through clearly.

meaningEn: the group leader has arranged things properly

sentences.hanzi: 既然组长已经安排妥当，大家就按计划执行吧。
sentences.pinyin: ji4 ran2 zu3 zhang3 yi3 jing1 an1 pai2 tuo3 dang4, da4 jia1 jiu4 an4 ji4 hua4 zhi2 xing2 ba5.
sentences.meaningKo: 조장이 이미 적절히 배치해 두었으니 모두 계획대로 실행하자.
sentences.meaningEn: Since the group leader has already arranged things properly, let everyone carry it out according to the plan.

meaningEn: to be prepared in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 他做事有准备，所以很少临时慌乱。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 you3 zhun3 bei4, suo3 yi3 hen3 shao3 lin2 shi2 huang1 luan4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 일할 때 준비가 잘 되어 있어서 갑자기 허둥대는 일이 거의 없다.
sentences.meaningEn: He is well prepared in doing things, so he rarely becomes flustered at the last minute.

meaningEn: the answering method is correct

sentences.hanzi: 只要作答方式正确，后面的步骤就容易多了。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 da2 fang1 shi4 zheng4 que4, hou4 mian4 de5 bu4 zhou4 jiu4 rong2 yi4 duo1 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 답안 작성 방식만 정확하면 뒤의 단계는 훨씬 쉬워진다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the answering method is correct, the following steps become much easier.

meaningEn: compositional thinking

sentences.hanzi: 多听多写有助于培养作曲思维。
sentences.pinyin: duo1 ting1 duo1 xie3 you3 zhu4 yu2 pei2 yang3 zuo4 qu3 si1 wei2.
sentences.meaningKo: 많이 듣고 많이 쓰는 것은 작곡 사고방식을 기르는 데 도움이 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: Listening and writing more helps cultivate compositional thinking.

meaningEn: to sit there and listen

sentences.hanzi: 你先坐在那里听，不明白再问。
sentences.pinyin: ni3 xian1 zuo4 zai4 na4 li3 ting1, bu4 ming2 bai2 zai4 wen4.
sentences.meaningKo: 너는 먼저 거기 앉아서 듣고 이해가 안 되면 다시 물어라.
sentences.meaningEn: Sit there and listen first, and ask again if you do not understand.

meaningEn: the group leader is responsible for explaining

sentences.hanzi: 如果大家有疑问，就由组长负责解释。
sentences.pinyin: ru2 guo3 da4 jia1 you3 yi2 wen4, jiu4 you2 zu3 zhang3 fu4 ze2 jie3 shi4.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두에게 의문이 있으면 조장이 설명을 책임진다.
sentences.meaningEn: If everyone has questions, the group leader will be responsible for explaining.

meaningEn: steady and conscientious in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 他做事踏实认真，所以很受领导赏识。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 ta4 shi2 ren4 zhen1, suo3 yi3 hen3 shou4 ling3 dao3 shang3 shi2.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 일을 착실하고 성실하게 해서 상사의 높은 평가를 받는다.
sentences.meaningEn: He is steady and conscientious in doing things, so he is highly appreciated by his leaders.

meaningEn: the workload is heavy

sentences.hanzi: 这段时间作业任务重，大家都辛苦了。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 duan4 shi2 jian1 zuo4 ye4 ren4 wu5 zhong4, da4 jia1 dou1 xin1 ku3 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 기간에는 작업 임무가 많아서 모두가 수고했다.
sentences.meaningEn: The workload has been heavy during this period, and everyone has worked hard.

meaningEn: to sit and organize materials

sentences.hanzi: 她下午一直坐着整理资料，忙到很晚。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xia4 wu3 yi4 zhi2 zuo4 zhe5 zheng3 li3 zi1 liao4, mang2 dao4 hen3 wan3.
sentences.meaningKo: 그녀는 오후 내내 앉아서 자료를 정리하느라 늦게까지 바빴다.
sentences.meaningEn: She spent the whole afternoon sitting and organizing materials, staying busy until late.

meaningEn: the group leader checks and controls quality

sentences.hanzi: 最后一轮审核要由组长把关。
sentences.pinyin: zui4 hou4 yi4 lun2 shen3 he2 yao4 you2 zu3 zhang3 ba3 guan1.
sentences.meaningKo: 마지막 한 차례의 심사는 조장이 최종 점검해야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: The final round of review must be checked and controlled by the group leader.

meaningEn: to keep one's word in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 和别人合作，首先得做事讲信用。
sentences.pinyin: he2 bie2 ren2 he2 zuo4, shou3 xian1 dei3 zuo4 shi4 jiang3 xin4 yong4.
sentences.meaningKo: 남과 협력하려면 무엇보다 먼저 일을 할 때 신용을 지켜야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: When cooperating with others, the first thing is to keep your word in doing things.

meaningEn: the work report is completed

sentences.hanzi: 作业报告完成以后，请先发给组长看。
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 ye4 bao4 gao4 wan2 cheng2 yi3 hou4, qing3 xian1 fa1 gei3 zu3 zhang3 kan4.
sentences.meaningKo: 작업 보고서가 완성되면 먼저 조장에게 보내 확인받아라.
sentences.meaningEn: After the work report is completed, please send it to the group leader first for review.

meaningEn: to sit there without moving

sentences.hanzi: 他受了伤，只能坐在那里不动。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shou4 le5 shang1, zhi3 neng2 zuo4 zai4 na4 li3 bu4 dong4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 다쳐서 거기 꼼짝 않고 앉아 있을 수밖에 없었다.
sentences.meaningEn: He was injured and could only sit there without moving.

meaningEn: the group leader explains the requirements clearly

sentences.hanzi: 只要组长先把要求讲清，大家做起来就容易多了。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zu3 zhang3 xian1 ba3 yao1 qiu2 jiang3 qing1, da4 jia1 zuo4 qi3 lai2 jiu4 rong2 yi4 duo1 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 조장이 먼저 요구 사항을 분명히 설명하기만 하면 모두가 훨씬 쉽게 할 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the group leader explains the requirements clearly first, it becomes much easier for everyone to do the work.

meaningEn: to follow rules in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 他做事守规矩，所以大家都很信任他。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 shou3 gui1 ju3, suo3 yi3 da4 jia1 dou1 hen3 xin4 ren4 ta1.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 일할 때 규칙을 잘 지켜서 모두가 그를 매우 신뢰한다.
sentences.meaningEn: He follows rules in doing things, so everyone trusts him very much.

meaningEn: schedule arrangement for the work

sentences.hanzi: 合理的作业时间安排能减少很多压力。
sentences.pinyin: he2 li3 de5 zuo4 ye4 shi2 jian1 an1 pai2 neng2 jian3 shao3 hen3 duo1 ya1 li4.
sentences.meaningKo: 합리적인 작업 시간 배치는 많은 부담을 줄일 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: A reasonable schedule arrangement for the work can reduce a lot of pressure.

meaningEn: to sit and wait for the result

sentences.hanzi: 与其坐着等结果，不如主动去推进进展。
sentences.pinyin: yu3 qi2 zuo4 zhe5 deng3 jie2 guo3, bu4 ru2 zhu3 dong4 qu4 tui1 jin4 jin4 zhan3.
sentences.meaningKo: 앉아서 결과를 기다리기보다는 스스로 적극적으로 진전을 밀어붙이는 편이 낫다.
sentences.meaningEn: Rather than sitting and waiting for the result, it is better to actively push the progress forward.

meaningEn: the group leader arranges a meeting

sentences.hanzi: 有重要事情时，组长会及时安排会议。
sentences.pinyin: you3 zhong4 yao4 shi4 qing2 shi2, zu3 zhang3 hui4 ji2 shi2 an1 pai2 hui4 yi4.
sentences.meaningKo: 중요한 일이 있을 때 조장은 제때 회의를 잡는다.
sentences.meaningEn: When there is something important, the group leader arranges a meeting in a timely manner.

meaningEn: not perfunctory in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 她做事不敷衍，所以每个细节都处理得很好。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 bu4 fu1 yan3, suo3 yi3 mei3 ge4 xi4 jie2 dou1 chu3 li3 de5 hen3 hao3.
sentences.meaningKo: 그녀는 일을 대충 하지 않아서 모든 세부를 아주 잘 처리한다.
sentences.meaningEn: She is not perfunctory in doing things, so every detail is handled very well.

meaningEn: explanation of the work situation

sentences.hanzi: 请把目前的作业情况说明整理成文字发过来。
sentences.pinyin: qing3 ba3 mu4 qian2 de5 zuo4 ye4 qing2 kuang4 shuo1 ming2 zheng3 li3 cheng2 wen2 zi4 fa1 guo4 lai2.
sentences.meaningKo: 현재의 작업 상황 설명을 글로 정리해서 보내 주세요.
sentences.meaningEn: Please organize the explanation of the current work situation into writing and send it over.

meaningEn: to sit and write a report

sentences.hanzi: 他一整天都坐着写报告，几乎没怎么休息。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 yi4 zheng3 tian1 dou1 zuo4 zhe5 xie3 bao4 gao4, ji1 hu1 mei2 zen3 me5 xiu1 xi5.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 하루 종일 앉아서 보고서를 쓰느라 거의 쉬지 못했다.
sentences.meaningEn: He spent the whole day sitting and writing a report, hardly resting at all.

meaningEn: the group leader makes the final decision

sentences.hanzi: 讨论了这么久，最后还是得由组长拍板。
sentences.pinyin: tao3 lun4 le5 zhe4 me5 jiu3, zui4 hou4 hai2 shi4 dei3 you2 zu3 zhang3 pai1 ban3.
sentences.meaningKo: 이렇게 오래 토론했지만 결국 마지막에는 조장이 최종 결정을 내려야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: After discussing for so long, in the end the group leader still has to make the final decision.

meaningEn: working rhythm; pace of the assignment

sentences.hanzi: 只要把作业节奏控制好，后面的压力就会小很多。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 ba3 zuo4 ye4 jie2 zou4 kong4 zhi4 hao3, hou4 mian4 de5 ya1 li4 jiu4 hui4 xiao3 hen3 duo1.
sentences.meaningKo: 작업 리듬만 잘 조절하면 뒤의 부담이 훨씬 줄어든다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as you control the working rhythm well, the pressure later on will be much smaller.

meaningEn: after giving a response

sentences.hanzi: 他做出回应后，现场的气氛才慢慢缓和下来。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 chu1 hui2 ying4 hou4, xian4 chang3 de5 qi4 fen1 cai2 man4 man4 huan3 he2 xia4 lai2.
sentences.meaningKo: 그가 응답한 뒤에야 현장의 분위기가 천천히 누그러졌다.
sentences.meaningEn: Only after he gave a response did the atmosphere on site gradually ease.

meaningEn: team members add supplementary opinions

sentences.hanzi: 在最终确定方案前，组员又补充了几条意见。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 zui4 zhong1 que4 ding4 fang1 an4 qian2, zu3 yuan2 you4 bu3 chong1 le5 ji3 tiao2 yi4 jian4.
sentences.meaningKo: 최종 방안을 확정하기 전에 조원들이 몇 가지 의견을 더 보충했다.
sentences.meaningEn: Before the final plan was confirmed, the team members added several more opinions.

meaningEn: to sit outside

sentences.hanzi: 天气凉快的时候，大家喜欢坐在外面聊天。
sentences.pinyin: tian1 qi4 liang2 kuai4 de5 shi2 hou4, da4 jia1 xi3 huan1 zuo4 zai4 wai4 mian4 liao2 tian1.
sentences.meaningKo: 날씨가 선선할 때는 모두가 밖에 앉아 이야기하는 것을 좋아한다.
sentences.meaningEn: When the weather is cool, everyone likes to sit outside and chat.

meaningEn: musical structure; structure of a composition

sentences.hanzi: 这首作品的作曲结构很完整，前后呼应得很好。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shou3 zuo4 pin3 de5 zuo4 qu3 jie2 gou4 hen3 wan2 zheng3, qian2 hou4 hu1 ying4 de5 hen3 hao3.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 작품의 작곡 구조는 매우 완전해서 앞뒤의 호응이 아주 좋다.
sentences.meaningEn: The musical structure of this piece is very complete, with excellent coherence from beginning to end.

meaningEn: to emphasize division of labor in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 团队做事要讲分工，不能什么都堆到一个人身上。
sentences.pinyin: tuan2 dui4 zuo4 shi4 yao4 jiang3 fen1 gong1, bu4 neng2 shen2 me5 dou1 dui1 dao4 yi2 ge4 ren2 shen1 shang4.
sentences.meaningKo: 팀은 일을 할 때 역할 분담을 중시해야지 모든 것을 한 사람에게 몰아서는 안 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: A team should emphasize division of labor when doing things and must not pile everything onto one person.

meaningEn: the workflow connection is smooth

sentences.hanzi: 前后作业衔接顺畅，整个流程就不会卡住。
sentences.pinyin: qian2 hou4 zuo4 ye4 xian2 jie1 shun4 chang4, zheng3 ge4 liu2 cheng2 jiu4 bu2 hui4 ka3 zhu4.
sentences.meaningKo: 앞뒤 작업 연계가 원활하면 전체 절차가 막히지 않는다.
sentences.meaningEn: If the workflow connection between stages is smooth, the whole process will not get stuck.

meaningEn: to sit and listen to others speak

sentences.hanzi: 先别急着下判断，坐着听别人说完再发表意见。
sentences.pinyin: xian1 bie2 ji2 zhe5 xia4 pan4 duan4, zuo4 zhe5 ting1 bie2 ren2 shuo1 wan2 zai4 fa1 biao3 yi4 jian4.
sentences.meaningKo: 먼저 서둘러 판단하지 말고 앉아서 다른 사람이 끝까지 말하는 것을 들은 뒤 의견을 말해라.
sentences.meaningEn: Do not rush to judge first; sit and listen to others finish speaking before expressing your opinion.

meaningEn: the group leader solicits team members' opinions

sentences.hanzi: 在修改方案之前，组长先征求了组员意见。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 xiu1 gai3 fang1 an4 zhi1 qian2, zu3 zhang3 xian1 zheng1 qiu2 le5 zu3 yuan2 yi4 jian4.
sentences.meaningKo: 방안을 수정하기 전에 조장은 먼저 조원들의 의견을 구했다.
sentences.meaningEn: Before revising the plan, the group leader first solicited the team members’ opinions.

meaningEn: to emphasize results/effectiveness in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 做事要讲效果，不能只看表面上忙不忙。
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 shi4 yao4 jiang3 xiao4 guo3, bu4 neng2 zhi3 kan4 biao3 mian4 shang4 mang2 bu4 mang2.
sentences.meaningKo: 일할 때는 실효를 중시해야지 겉으로 바쁜지만 봐서는 안 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: When doing things, one should emphasize effectiveness and not judge only by whether people look busy on the surface.

meaningEn: the answering logic is clear

sentences.hanzi: 只要作答思路清楚，就算题难也不容易慌。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 da2 si1 lu4 qing1 chu3, jiu4 suan4 ti2 nan2 ye3 bu4 rong2 yi4 huang1.
sentences.meaningKo: 답안 풀이 흐름만 분명하면 문제가 어려워도 쉽게 당황하지 않는다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the answering logic is clear, even difficult questions do not easily cause panic.

meaningEn: the compositional direction is clear

sentences.hanzi: 方向一旦明确，后面的创作就顺手多了。
sentences.pinyin: fang1 xiang4 yi2 dan4 ming2 que4, hou4 mian4 de5 chuang4 zuo4 jiu4 shun4 shou3 duo1 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 방향만 한 번 분명해지면 뒤의 창작은 훨씬 손에 익는다.
sentences.meaningEn: Once the direction becomes clear, the subsequent creation goes much more smoothly.

meaningEn: to sit and sort out one's thoughts

sentences.hanzi: 他先坐着整理思路，然后才开始动笔。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xian1 zuo4 zhe5 zheng3 li3 si1 lu4, ran2 hou4 cai2 kai1 shi3 dong4 bi3.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 먼저 앉아서 생각을 정리한 뒤에야 쓰기 시작했다.
sentences.meaningEn: He first sat and sorted out his thoughts, and only then began writing.

meaningEn: the group leader clarifies the division of labor

sentences.hanzi: 只要组长把分工明确好，后面推进就会轻松很多。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zu3 zhang3 ba3 fen1 gong1 ming2 que4 hao3, hou4 mian4 tui1 jin4 jiu4 hui4 qing1 song1 hen3 duo1.
sentences.meaningKo: 조장이 역할 분담을 명확히 해 두기만 하면 이후 추진은 훨씬 수월해진다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the group leader clearly defines the division of labor, the subsequent progress becomes much easier.

meaningEn: to be clear-cut and not sloppy in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 他做事不含糊，答应了就一定会去做。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 bu4 han2 hu5, da1 ying5 le5 jiu4 yi2 ding4 hui4 qu4 zuo4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 일할 때 흐리멍덩하지 않아서 일단 약속하면 반드시 해낸다.
sentences.meaningEn: He is clear-cut in doing things; once he agrees, he will definitely do it.

meaningEn: assignment of work tasks

sentences.hanzi: 合理的作业任务分配能避免很多重复劳动。
sentences.pinyin: he2 li3 de5 zuo4 ye4 ren4 wu5 fen1 pei4 neng2 bi4 mian3 hen3 duo1 chong2 fu4 lao2 dong4.
sentences.meaningKo: 합리적인 작업 임무 분배는 많은 중복 노동을 피하게 해 준다.
sentences.meaningEn: A reasonable assignment of work tasks can avoid a lot of repeated labor.

meaningEn: to sit and wait for arrangements

sentences.hanzi: 大家先坐着等安排，不要自己乱行动。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 xian1 zuo4 zhe5 deng3 an1 pai2, bu2 yao4 zi4 ji3 luan4 xing2 dong4.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두 먼저 앉아서 배치를 기다리고 제멋대로 움직이지 마라.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone should sit and wait for arrangements first and not act on their own.

meaningEn: the group leader checks the progress

sentences.hanzi: 每天下午，组长都会统一检查一下进度。
sentences.pinyin: mei3 tian1 xia4 wu3, zu3 zhang3 dou1 hui4 tong3 yi1 jian3 cha2 yi2 xia4 jin4 du4.
sentences.meaningKo: 매일 오후 조장은 진도를 한 번씩 통일적으로 점검한다.
sentences.meaningEn: Every afternoon, the group leader checks the progress in a unified way.

meaningEn: to seek steadiness in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 他做事求稳，所以宁可慢一点也不愿意出错。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 qiu2 wen3, suo3 yi3 ning4 ke3 man4 yi4 dian3 ye3 bu2 yuan4 yi4 chu1 cuo4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 일할 때 안정성을 추구해서 조금 느리더라도 실수하는 것을 원치 않는다.
sentences.meaningEn: He seeks steadiness in doing things, so he would rather be a little slower than make mistakes.

meaningEn: the assignment requirements have changed

sentences.hanzi: 最新通知说，这次作业要求变了。
sentences.pinyin: zui4 xin1 tong1 zhi1 shuo1, zhe4 ci4 zuo4 ye4 yao1 qiu2 bian4 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 최신 공지에 따르면 이번 과제 요구 사항이 바뀌었다.
sentences.meaningEn: The latest notice says that the requirements for this assignment have changed.

meaningEn: to sit and wait for the teacher to come

sentences.hanzi: 大家先坐着等老师来，不要在教室里乱跑。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 xian1 zuo4 zhe5 deng3 lao3 shi1 lai2, bu2 yao4 zai4 jiao4 shi4 li3 luan4 pao3.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두 먼저 앉아서 선생님이 오기를 기다리고 교실 안에서 뛰어다니지 마라.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone should sit and wait for the teacher to come, and not run around the classroom.

meaningEn: group leader's concluding remarks

sentences.hanzi: 最后由组长做总结发言，明确下一步安排。
sentences.pinyin: zui4 hou4 you2 zu3 zhang3 zuo4 zong3 jie2 fa1 yan2, ming2 que4 xia4 yi2 bu4 an1 pai2.
sentences.meaningKo: 마지막에는 조장이 총정리 발언을 하며 다음 단계 배치를 분명히 했다.
sentences.meaningEn: Finally, the group leader gave concluding remarks and clarified the next step arrangements.

meaningEn: to emphasize principles in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 管理工作不能只讲人情，还得讲原则性。
sentences.pinyin: guan3 li3 gong1 zuo4 bu4 neng2 zhi3 jiang3 ren2 qing2, hai2 dei3 jiang3 yuan2 ze2 xing4.
sentences.meaningKo: 관리 업무는 인정만 따져서는 안 되고 원칙성도 중시해야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: Management work cannot rely only on personal feelings; it must also emphasize principles.

meaningEn: work instruction manual; assignment guide

sentences.hanzi: 新设备旁边放着一份详细的作业说明书。
sentences.pinyin: xin1 she4 bei4 pang2 bian1 fang4 zhe5 yi2 fen4 xiang2 xi4 de5 zuo4 ye4 shuo1 ming2 shu1.
sentences.meaningKo: 새 장비 옆에는 상세한 작업 설명서 한 부가 놓여 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: A detailed work instruction manual is placed beside the new equipment.

meaningEn: to sit and think things over

sentences.hanzi: 他一个人坐着想事情，谁也没有去打扰他。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 yi2 ge4 ren2 zuo4 zhe5 xiang3 shi4 qing2, shui2 ye3 mei2 you3 qu4 da3 rao3 ta1.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 혼자 앉아서 일을 생각하고 있었고 아무도 그를 방해하러 가지 않았다.
sentences.meaningEn: He sat alone thinking things over, and no one went to disturb him.

meaningEn: the group leader is responsible for scheduling progress

sentences.hanzi: 整个项目的推进节奏由组长负责安排进度。
sentences.pinyin: zheng3 ge4 xiang4 mu4 de5 tui1 jin4 jie2 zou4 you2 zu3 zhang3 fu4 ze2 an1 pai2 jin4 du4.
sentences.meaningKo: 전체 프로젝트의 추진 리듬은 조장이 진도 배치를 책임진다.
sentences.meaningEn: The overall pace of project advancement is scheduled by the group leader.

meaningEn: to act with confidence and assurance

sentences.hanzi: 只有准备充分，做事才会更有把握。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 you3 zhun3 bei4 chong1 fen4, zuo4 shi4 cai2 hui4 geng4 you3 ba3 wo4.
sentences.meaningKo: 준비가 충분해야 일을 할 때 더 확신을 가질 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: Only with sufficient preparation can one act with greater confidence.

meaningEn: adjustment of the work plan

sentences.hanzi: 根据最新情况，我们对作业计划做了调整。
sentences.pinyin: gen1 ju4 zui4 xin1 qing2 kuang4, wo3 men5 dui4 zuo4 ye4 ji4 hua4 zuo4 le5 tiao2 zheng3.
sentences.meaningKo: 최신 상황에 따라 우리는 작업 계획을 조정했다.
sentences.meaningEn: According to the latest situation, we adjusted the work plan.

meaningEn: to sit and write materials/documents

sentences.hanzi: 他昨晚一直坐着写材料，忙到深夜。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo2 wan3 yi4 zhi2 zuo4 zhe5 xie3 cai2 liao4, mang2 dao4 shen1 ye4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 어젯밤 내내 앉아서 자료를 작성하느라 밤늦게까지 바빴다.
sentences.meaningEn: He spent last night sitting and writing documents, staying busy until late at night.

meaningEn: the group leader coordinates in a unified way

sentences.hanzi: 涉及多个小组的时候，需要由组长统一协调。
sentences.pinyin: she4 ji2 duo1 ge4 xiao3 zu3 de5 shi2 hou4, xu1 yao4 you2 zu3 zhang3 tong3 yi1 xie2 tiao2.
sentences.meaningKo: 여러 소조가 관련될 때는 조장이 통일적으로 조정해야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: When multiple teams are involved, the group leader needs to coordinate in a unified way.

meaningEn: work order; sequence of the assignment

sentences.hanzi: 先把作业顺序排好，做起来就不会乱。
sentences.pinyin: xian1 ba3 zuo4 ye4 shun4 xu4 pai2 hao3, zuo4 qi3 lai2 jiu4 bu2 hui4 luan4.
sentences.meaningKo: 먼저 작업 순서를 잘 정해 두면 진행할 때 혼란스럽지 않다.
sentences.meaningEn: If the work order is arranged well first, things will not become chaotic when doing it.

meaningEn: to give a promise; to agree

sentences.hanzi: 没有把握之前，不要轻易做出答应。
sentences.pinyin: mei2 you3 ba3 wo4 zhi1 qian2, bu2 yao4 qing1 yi4 zuo4 chu1 da1 ying4.
sentences.meaningKo: 확신이 없기 전에는 쉽게 승낙하지 마라.
sentences.meaningEn: Before being sure, do not agree lightly.

meaningEn: team members raise questions

sentences.hanzi: 开会时，组员可以随时提出问题。
sentences.pinyin: kai1 hui4 shi2, zu3 yuan2 ke3 yi3 sui2 shi2 ti2 chu1 wen4 ti2.
sentences.meaningKo: 회의할 때 조원들은 언제든 질문을 제기할 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: During the meeting, team members can raise questions at any time.

meaningEn: to sit in the front

sentences.hanzi: 坐在前边的人看得更清楚，也更方便提问。
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 zai4 qian2 bian1 de5 ren2 kan4 de5 geng4 qing1 chu3, ye3 geng4 fang1 bian4 ti2 wen4.
sentences.meaningKo: 앞쪽에 앉은 사람들은 더 잘 볼 수 있고 질문하기도 더 편하다.
sentences.meaningEn: People sitting in the front can see more clearly and also ask questions more conveniently.

meaningEn: composition level is stable

sentences.hanzi: 经过长期训练以后，他的作曲水平已经比较稳定了。
sentences.pinyin: jing1 guo4 chang2 qi1 xun4 lian4 yi3 hou4, ta1 de5 zuo4 qu3 shui3 ping2 yi3 jing1 bi3 jiao4 wen3 ding4 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 장기간 훈련한 뒤 그의 작곡 수준은 이미 비교적 안정적이 되었다.
sentences.meaningEn: After long-term training, his composition level has become relatively stable.

meaningEn: to emphasize coordination in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 团队做事要讲配合，不能各干各的。
sentences.pinyin: tuan2 dui4 zuo4 shi4 yao4 jiang3 pei4 he2, bu4 neng2 ge4 gan4 ge4 de5.
sentences.meaningKo: 팀이 일을 할 때는 협조를 중시해야지 제각기 따로 해서는 안 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: When a team does things, it must emphasize coordination and cannot have everyone doing their own thing separately.

meaningEn: detailed rules of the assignment; work details and regulations

sentences.hanzi: 正式开始前，先把作业细则看一遍。
sentences.pinyin: zheng4 shi4 kai1 shi3 qian2, xian1 ba3 zuo4 ye4 xi4 ze2 kan4 yi2 bian4.
sentences.meaningKo: 정식으로 시작하기 전에 먼저 작업 세칙을 한 번 읽어 보아라.
sentences.meaningEn: Before officially starting, first read through the detailed rules of the assignment once.

meaningEn: to speak while seated

sentences.hanzi: 如果不方便站起来，也可以坐着发言。
sentences.pinyin: ru2 guo3 bu4 fang1 bian4 zhan4 qi3 lai2, ye3 ke3 yi3 zuo4 zhe5 fa1 yan2.
sentences.meaningKo: 일어나기 불편하면 앉은 채 발언해도 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: If it is inconvenient to stand up, you may also speak while seated.

meaningEn: the group leader sorts out opinions

sentences.hanzi: 讨论完以后，组长负责整理大家的意见。
sentences.pinyin: tao3 lun4 wan2 yi3 hou4, zu3 zhang3 fu4 ze2 zheng3 li3 da4 jia1 de5 yi4 jian4.
sentences.meaningKo: 토론이 끝난 뒤에는 조장이 모두의 의견을 정리하는 책임을 진다.
sentences.meaningEn: After the discussion is over, the group leader is responsible for sorting out everyone’s opinions.

meaningEn: to have principles in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 他做事有原则，所以处理问题时很少摇摆。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 you3 yuan2 ze2, suo3 yi3 chu3 li3 wen4 ti2 shi2 hen3 shao3 yao2 bai3.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 일할 때 원칙이 있어서 문제를 처리할 때 거의 흔들리지 않는다.
sentences.meaningEn: He has principles in doing things, so he rarely wavers when handling problems.

meaningEn: key point of answering

sentences.hanzi: 老师先提醒了大家这道题的作答重点。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 shi1 xian1 ti2 xing3 le5 da4 jia1 zhe4 dao4 ti2 de5 zuo4 da2 zhong4 dian3.
sentences.meaningKo: 선생님은 먼저 모두에게 이 문제의 답안 작성 핵심 포인트를 일러 주었다.
sentences.meaningEn: The teacher first reminded everyone of the key point for answering this question.

meaningEn: way of composing; compositional method

sentences.hanzi: 每个人的作曲方式都不一样，没有固定答案。
sentences.pinyin: mei3 ge4 ren2 de5 zuo4 qu3 fang1 shi4 dou1 bu4 yi2 yang4, mei2 you3 gu4 ding4 da2 an4.
sentences.meaningKo: 사람마다 작곡 방식은 모두 다르며 정해진 답은 없다.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone’s way of composing is different, and there is no fixed answer.

meaningEn: to sit and take notes

sentences.hanzi: 他整场讲座都安静地坐着做笔记。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zheng3 chang3 jiang3 zuo4 dou1 an1 jing4 di5 zuo4 zhe5 zuo4 bi3 ji4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 강연 내내 조용히 앉아서 필기했다.
sentences.meaningEn: He sat quietly taking notes throughout the entire lecture.

meaningEn: the group leader explains the requirements

sentences.hanzi: 开始之前，组长先说明了这次任务的要求。
sentences.pinyin: kai1 shi3 zhi1 qian2, zu3 zhang3 xian1 shuo1 ming2 le5 zhe4 ci4 ren4 wu5 de5 yao1 qiu2.
sentences.meaningKo: 시작하기 전에 조장은 이번 임무의 요구 사항을 먼저 설명했다.
sentences.meaningEn: Before starting, the group leader first explained the requirements of this task.

meaningEn: to be steady and mature in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 他做事稳重，所以关键任务交给他最放心。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 wen3 zhong4, suo3 yi3 guan1 jian4 ren4 wu5 jiao1 gei3 ta1 zui4 fang4 xin1.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 일할 때 침착하고 신중해서 중요한 임무를 맡기기에 가장 안심된다.
sentences.meaningEn: He is steady and mature in doing things, so people feel most at ease entrusting key tasks to him.

meaningEn: the division of work is clear

sentences.hanzi: 只要作业分工明确，效率就会提高不少。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 ye4 fen1 gong1 ming2 que4, xiao4 lv4 jiu4 hui4 ti2 gao1 bu4 shao3.
sentences.meaningKo: 작업 분담만 명확하면 효율은 적잖이 높아진다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the division of work is clear, efficiency will improve considerably.

meaningEn: to sit and wait for the vehicle/bus

sentences.hanzi: 外面风大，我们就在里面坐着等车吧。
sentences.pinyin: wai4 mian4 feng1 da4, wo3 men5 jiu4 zai4 li3 mian4 zuo4 zhe5 deng3 che1 ba5.
sentences.meaningKo: 밖은 바람이 세니 우리는 안에서 앉아서 차를 기다리자.
sentences.meaningEn: The wind is strong outside, so let us sit inside and wait for the vehicle.

meaningEn: the group leader collects opinions

sentences.hanzi: 方案修改前，组长先把大家的意见都收集起来。
sentences.pinyin: fang1 an4 xiu1 gai3 qian2, zu3 zhang3 xian1 ba3 da4 jia1 de5 yi4 jian4 dou1 shou1 ji2 qi3 lai2.
sentences.meaningKo: 방안을 수정하기 전에 조장은 먼저 모두의 의견을 전부 수집했다.
sentences.meaningEn: Before revising the plan, the group leader first collected everyone’s opinions.

meaningEn: to know priorities in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 做事要有轻重缓急，不能什么都一起抓。
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 shi4 yao4 you3 qing1 zhong4 huan3 ji2, bu4 neng2 shen2 me5 dou1 yi4 qi3 zhua1.
sentences.meaningKo: 일할 때는 경중과 완급을 알아야지 모든 것을 한꺼번에 잡아서는 안 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: When doing things, one must know priorities and urgency, and cannot try to handle everything at once.

meaningEn: adjustment of assignment requirements

sentences.hanzi: 因为时间变化，这次作业要求做了一些调整。
sentences.pinyin: yin1 wei4 shi2 jian1 bian4 hua4, zhe4 ci4 zuo4 ye4 yao1 qiu2 zuo4 le5 yi4 xie1 tiao2 zheng3.
sentences.meaningKo: 시간 변화 때문에 이번 과제 요구 사항에 몇 가지 조정이 있었다.
sentences.meaningEn: Because of schedule changes, some adjustments were made to the requirements of this assignment.

meaningEn: to sit and wait for news

sentences.hanzi: 与其坐着等消息，不如主动去问一问。
sentences.pinyin: yu3 qi2 zuo4 zhe5 deng3 xiao1 xi5, bu4 ru2 zhu3 dong4 qu4 wen4 yi2 wen4.
sentences.meaningKo: 앉아서 소식을 기다리기보다는 스스로 가서 한번 물어보는 편이 낫다.
sentences.meaningEn: Rather than sitting and waiting for news, it is better to take the initiative and ask.

meaningEn: the group leader arranged things properly

sentences.hanzi: 这次能够顺利完成，多亏组长安排得当。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ci4 neng2 gou4 shun4 li4 wan2 cheng2, duo1 kui1 zu3 zhang3 an1 pai2 de5 dang4.
sentences.meaningKo: 이번에 순조롭게 완수할 수 있었던 것은 조장이 적절히 배치한 덕분이다.
sentences.meaningEn: The reason this task could be completed smoothly is largely thanks to the group leader’s proper arrangements.

meaningEn: not hesitant in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 他做事不犹豫，所以效率一直很高。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 bu4 you2 yu4, suo3 yi3 xiao4 lv4 yi4 zhi2 hen3 gao1.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 일할 때 망설이지 않아서 효율이 늘 매우 높다.
sentences.meaningEn: He is not hesitant in doing things, so his efficiency has always been high.

meaningEn: the work record is complete

sentences.hanzi: 只要作业记录完整，后面追踪就会方便很多。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 ye4 ji4 lu4 wan2 zheng3, hou4 mian4 zhui1 zong1 jiu4 hui4 fang1 bian4 hen3 duo1.
sentences.meaningKo: 작업 기록만 완전하면 이후 추적이 훨씬 편해진다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the work record is complete, later tracking will become much more convenient.

meaningEn: to sit and think of a solution

sentences.hanzi: 与其着急，不如先坐着想办法。
sentences.pinyin: yu3 qi2 zhao2 ji2, bu4 ru2 xian1 zuo4 zhe5 xiang3 ban4 fa3.
sentences.meaningKo: 조급해하기보다는 먼저 앉아서 방법을 생각해 보는 편이 낫다.
sentences.meaningEn: Rather than getting anxious, it is better to sit down first and think of a solution.

meaningEn: the group leader coordinates and arranges as a whole

sentences.hanzi: 整个活动由组长统筹安排，大家按分工配合就行。
sentences.pinyin: zheng3 ge4 huo2 dong4 you2 zu3 zhang3 tong3 chou2 an1 pai2, da4 jia1 an4 fen1 gong1 pei4 he2 jiu4 xing2.
sentences.meaningKo: 전체 활동은 조장이 총괄해서 배치하니 모두 역할 분담에 맞춰 협력하면 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: The whole activity is coordinated and arranged by the group leader, so everyone only needs to cooperate according to the division of labor.

meaningEn: one must be careful in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 做事要细心，很多错误都是粗心造成的。
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 shi4 yao4 xi4 xin1, hen3 duo1 cuo4 wu4 dou1 shi4 cu1 xin1 zao4 cheng2 de5.
sentences.meaningKo: 일할 때는 세심해야 하며 많은 실수는 부주의 때문에 생긴다.
sentences.meaningEn: One must be careful in doing things, as many mistakes are caused by carelessness.

meaningEn: the operating procedure is standardized

sentences.hanzi: 作业程序规范以后，安全问题就少了很多。
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 ye4 cheng2 xu4 gui1 fan4 yi3 hou4, an1 quan2 wen4 ti2 jiu4 shao3 le5 hen3 duo1.
sentences.meaningKo: 작업 절차가 규범화된 뒤에는 안전 문제가 훨씬 줄었다.
sentences.meaningEn: After the operating procedure became standardized, safety problems decreased greatly.

meaningEn: to sit and wait for class to end

sentences.hanzi: 别只顾着坐着等下课，先把重点记下来。
sentences.pinyin: bie2 zhi3 gu4 zhe5 zuo4 zhe5 deng3 xia4 ke4, xian1 ba3 zhong4 dian3 ji4 xia4 lai2.
sentences.meaningKo: 그저 앉아서 수업이 끝나기만 기다리지 말고 먼저 핵심을 적어 두어라.
sentences.meaningEn: Do not just sit and wait for class to end; first write down the key points.

meaningEn: the group leader arranges the work

sentences.hanzi: 组长已经把今天的工作都安排好了。
sentences.pinyin: zu3 zhang3 yi3 jing1 ba3 jin1 tian1 de5 gong1 zuo4 dou1 an1 pai2 hao3 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 조장은 오늘의 업무를 이미 모두 잘 배치해 두었다.
sentences.meaningEn: The group leader has already arranged all of today’s work.

meaningEn: the workflow is clear

sentences.hanzi: 只要作业流程明确，后续推进就会顺利很多。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 ye4 liu2 cheng2 ming2 que4, hou4 xu4 tui1 jin4 jiu4 hui4 shun4 li4 hen3 duo1.
sentences.meaningKo: 작업 절차만 명확하면 후속 추진은 훨씬 순조로워진다.

meaningEn: after making a judgment

sentences.hanzi: 做出判断后，就要尽快采取行动。

sentences.meaningEn: After making a judgment, one should take action as quickly as possible.

meaningEn: team members remind each other

sentences.hanzi: 为了避免出错，组员之间会互相提醒。
sentences.pinyin: wei4 le5 bi4 mian3 chu1 cuo4, zu3 yuan2 zhi1 jian1 hui4 hu4 xiang1 ti2 xing3.

meaningEn: to sit inside

sentences.hanzi: 外面太吵了，我们还是坐在里面谈吧。
sentences.pinyin: wai4 mian4 tai4 chao3 le5, wo3 men5 hai2 shi4 zuo4 zai4 li3 mian4 tan2 ba5.
sentences.meaningKo: 밖이 너무 시끄러우니 우리는 안쪽에 앉아 이야기하는 편이 낫다.

meaningEn: the musical content is rich

sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shou3 zuo4 pin3 sui1 ran2 pian1 fu2 bu4 chang2, dan4 zuo4 qu3 nei4 rong2 hen3 feng1 fu4.

meaningEn: to emphasize responsibility in doing things

sentences.meaningEn: When doing things, one must emphasize responsibility and not shift the blame to each other when problems arise.

meaningEn: the work plan is clear

sentences.hanzi: 计划一旦明确，执行起来就省力多了。

sentences.meaningKo: 계획만 한 번 명확해지면 실행은 훨씬 수월해진다.
sentences.meaningEn: Once the plan becomes clear, carrying it out becomes much easier.

meaningEn: to sit and wait for notice to come

meaningEn: the group leader gives a unified explanation

sentences.meaningEn: To avoid misunderstanding, the relevant requirements are explained in a unified way by the group leader.

meaningEn: to emphasize attitude in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 能力可以慢慢提高，但做事首先得讲态度。
sentences.pinyin: neng2 li4 ke3 yi3 man4 man4 ti2 gao1, dan4 zuo4 shi4 shou3 xian1 dei3 jiang3 tai4 du4.
sentences.meaningKo: 능력은 천천히 높일 수 있지만 일을 할 때는 무엇보다 먼저 태도를 중시해야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: Ability can improve gradually, but in doing things one must first emphasize attitude.

meaningEn: the answer content is complete

sentences.hanzi: 只要作答内容完整，分数一般不会太低。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 da2 nei4 rong2 wan2 zheng3, fen1 shu4 yi4 ban1 bu2 hui4 tai4 di1.
sentences.meaningKo: 답안 내용만 완전하면 점수가 보통 너무 낮지는 않다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the answer content is complete, the score generally will not be too low.

meaningEn: form of composition; musical form

sentences.hanzi: 不同题材适合不同的作曲形式。
sentences.pinyin: bu4 tong2 ti2 cai2 shi4 he2 bu4 tong2 de5 zuo4 qu3 xing2 shi4.
sentences.meaningKo: 서로 다른 소재는 서로 다른 작곡 형식에 어울린다.
sentences.meaningEn: Different subjects suit different forms of composition.

meaningEn: to sit and turn on the computer

sentences.meaningEn: As soon as he entered the office, he sat down, turned on the computer, and started working.

meaningEn: the group leader makes the final confirmation

sentences.hanzi: 方案修改完以后，还要由组长最后确认。

sentences.meaningKo: 방안 수정이 끝난 뒤에도 조장이 최종 확인해야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: After the plan is revised, it still needs final confirmation by the group leader.

meaningEn: to have a goal in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 做事有目标，努力才不会白费。
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 shi4 you3 mu4 biao1, nu3 li4 cai2 bu2 hui4 bai2 fei4.
sentences.meaningKo: 일할 때 목표가 있어야 노력이 헛되지 않는다.
sentences.meaningEn: Only when you have a goal in doing things will your efforts not be wasted.

meaningEn: the workload increases

sentences.hanzi: 最近项目变多了，大家的作业量也跟着增加。

sentences.meaningEn: Recently there have been more projects, and everyone’s workload has increased accordingly.

meaningEn: to sit and listen to the arrangements

sentences.meaningKo: 모두 먼저 앉아서 배치를 듣고 다 들은 뒤에 질문해라.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone should first sit and listen to the arrangements, and ask questions after listening to everything.

meaningEn: the group leader explains the requirements clearly

sentences.hanzi: 只要组长把要求说清楚，执行起来就容易了。

sentences.meaningKo: 조장이 요구 사항을 분명히 말해 주기만 하면 실행은 쉬워진다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the group leader explains the requirements clearly, carrying them out becomes easier.

meaningEn: to have endurance in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 做事有耐力的人，更容易把长期任务坚持到底。

sentences.meaningEn: People who have endurance in doing things are more likely to carry long-term tasks through to the end.

meaningEn: the assignment requirements are unified

sentences.hanzi: 只要作业要求统一，大家执行起来就不会偏差太大。

sentences.meaningKo: 과제 요구 사항만 통일되어 있으면 모두가 실행할 때 편차가 너무 커지지 않는다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the assignment requirements are unified, the differences in execution will not become too large.

meaningEn: to sit and wait for it to start

sentences.hanzi: 大家先坐着等开始，不要随便走动。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 xian1 zuo4 zhe5 deng3 kai1 shi3, bu2 yao4 sui2 bian4 zou3 dong4.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두 먼저 앉아서 시작을 기다리고 함부로 돌아다니지 마라.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone should sit and wait for it to start, and not move around casually.

meaningEn: the group leader assigns personnel

sentences.hanzi: 这次活动由组长统一安排人员。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ci4 huo2 dong4 you2 zu3 zhang3 tong3 yi1 an1 pai2 ren2 yuan2.
sentences.meaningKo: 이번 활동은 조장이 인원을 통일적으로 배치한다.

meaningEn: to be resourceful in doing things

sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 you3 ban4 fa3, suo3 yi3 zong3 neng2 ba3 fu4 za2 wen4 ti2 li3 shun4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 일할 때 방법이 있어서 늘 복잡한 문제를 잘 정리해 낸다.
sentences.meaningEn: He is resourceful in doing things, so he can always sort out complex problems.

meaningEn: the work arrangement is reasonable

sentences.hanzi: 只要作业安排合理，团队的压力就不会太大。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 ye4 an1 pai2 he2 li3, tuan2 dui4 de5 ya1 li4 jiu4 bu2 hui4 tai4 da4.
sentences.meaningKo: 작업 배치만 합리적이면 팀의 부담은 너무 커지지 않는다.

meaningEn: to sit and listen to the explanation

sentences.meaningKo: 모두 먼저 앉아서 설명을 듣고 분명히 이해한 뒤에 다시 시작하자.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone should first sit and listen to the explanation, and start only after understanding it clearly.

meaningEn: the group leader reminds everyone

sentences.hanzi: 开始前，组长先提醒大家注意时间。
sentences.pinyin: kai1 shi3 qian2, zu3 zhang3 xian1 ti2 xing3 da4 jia1 zhu4 yi4 shi2 jian1.
sentences.meaningKo: 시작 전에 조장은 먼저 모두에게 시간에 주의하라고 일러 주었다.

meaningEn: to be experienced in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 他做事有经验，所以处理突发情况很冷静。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 you3 jing1 yan4, suo3 yi3 chu3 li3 tu1 fa1 qing2 kuang4 hen3 leng3 jing4.

sentences.meaningEn: He is experienced in doing things, so he stays very calm when handling emergencies.

meaningEn: the work status is stable

sentences.hanzi: 只要设备正常，整个作业状态就比较稳定。

sentences.meaningKo: 장비만 정상이면 전체 작업 상태는 비교적 안정적이다.

meaningEn: to sit and listen until the arrangements are finished

sentences.hanzi: 大家先坐着把安排听完，再开始行动。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 xian1 zuo4 zhe5 ba3 an1 pai2 ting1 wan2, zai4 kai1 shi3 xing2 dong4.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두 먼저 앉아서 배치를 끝까지 듣고 그다음 행동을 시작하자.

sentences.hanzi: 这次活动之所以顺利，是因为组长安排得很细。

sentences.meaningKo: 이번 활동이 순조로웠던 것은 조장이 아주 세세하게 배치했기 때문이다.
sentences.meaningEn: The reason this activity went smoothly is that the group leader arranged everything in great detail.

meaningEn: the key points of the work are clear

sentences.hanzi: 只要作业重点明确，后面的推进就会更有方向。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 ye4 zhong4 dian3 ming2 que4, hou4 mian4 de5 tui1 jin4 jiu4 hui4 geng4 you3 fang1 xiang4.
sentences.meaningKo: 작업 중점만 명확하면 이후 추진은 훨씬 더 방향이 생긴다.

meaningEn: after giving an explanation

sentences.hanzi: 他做出说明后，大家对这件事的误会就少了很多。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 chu1 shuo1 ming2 hou4, da4 jia1 dui4 zhe4 jian4 shi4 de5 wu4 hui4 jiu4 shao3 le5 hen3 duo1.

sentences.meaningEn: After he gave an explanation, everyone’s misunderstanding about the matter was greatly reduced.

meaningEn: team members act in a unified way

sentences.hanzi: 为了提高效率，组员需要统一行动。
sentences.pinyin: wei4 le5 ti2 gao1 xiao4 lv4, zu3 yuan2 xu1 yao4 tong3 yi1 xing2 dong4.
sentences.meaningKo: 효율을 높이기 위해 조원들은 통일적으로 행동해야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: To improve efficiency, the team members need to act in a unified way.

meaningEn: to sit nearby and listen

sentences.hanzi: 你先坐在旁边听，有问题等会儿再问。
sentences.pinyin: ni3 xian1 zuo4 zai4 pang2 bian1 ting1, you3 wen4 ti2 deng3 hui4 er5 zai4 wen4.
sentences.meaningKo: 너는 먼저 옆에 앉아 듣고 질문이 있으면 이따가 다시 물어라.

meaningEn: the compositional ideas are mature

sentences.hanzi: 虽然他年纪不大，但作曲想法已经很成熟了。
sentences.pinyin: sui1 ran2 ta1 nian2 ji4 bu4 da4, dan4 zuo4 qu3 xiang3 fa3 yi3 jing1 hen3 cheng2 shu2 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 나이는 많지 않지만 작곡 아이디어는 이미 매우 성숙하다.

meaningEn: to focus on key points in doing things

sentences.pinyin: shi2 jian1 you3 xian4, zuo4 shi4 yi2 ding4 yao4 jiang3 zhong4 dian3.
sentences.meaningKo: 시간이 제한되어 있으니 일을 할 때는 반드시 핵심을 중시해야 한다.

meaningEn: the assignment requirements are detailed

sentences.hanzi: 这次作业要求很详细，大家照着做就行。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ci4 zuo4 ye4 yao1 qiu2 hen3 xiang2 xi4, da4 jia1 zhao4 zhe5 zuo4 jiu4 xing2.

sentences.meaningEn: The requirements for this assignment are very detailed, so everyone just needs to follow them.

meaningEn: to sit and listen to the discussion

sentences.hanzi: 他先坐着听讨论，没有急着发表看法。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xian1 zuo4 zhe5 ting1 tao3 lun4, mei2 you3 ji2 zhe5 fa1 biao3 kan4 fa3.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 먼저 앉아서 토론을 듣고 서둘러 견해를 밝히지 않았다.
sentences.meaningEn: He first sat and listened to the discussion and did not rush to express his opinion.

meaningEn: the group leader makes arrangements

sentences.hanzi: 情况一有变化，组长就会及时做出安排。

sentences.meaningKo: 상황에 변화가 생기면 조장은 곧바로 제때 배치를 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: As soon as the situation changes, the group leader will make arrangements promptly.

meaningEn: to be very steady and down-to-earth in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 他做事很踏实，所以交给他的任务都很让人放心。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 hen3 ta4 shi2, suo3 yi3 jiao1 gei3 ta1 de5 ren4 wu5 dou1 hen3 rang4 ren2 fang4 xin1.

sentences.meaningEn: He is very steady and down-to-earth in doing things, so any task entrusted to him is very reassuring.

meaningEn: the answering logic is clear

sentences.hanzi: 只要作答逻辑清晰，阅卷的人就更容易理解。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 da2 luo2 ji2 qing1 xi1, yue4 juan4 de5 ren2 jiu4 geng4 rong2 yi4 li3 jie3.
sentences.meaningKo: 답안 논리만 명확하면 채점하는 사람도 훨씬 이해하기 쉽다.
