meaningEn: to have a strong sense of rhythm in composition

sentences.hanzi: 他的作品作曲节奏感强，很容易带动情绪。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 de5 zuo4 pin3 zuo4 qu3 jie2 zou4 gan3 qiang2, hen3 rong2 yi4 dai4 dong4 qing2 xu4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그의 작품은 작곡 리듬감이 강해서 감정을 이끌어 내기 쉽다.
sentences.meaningEn: His works have a strong rhythmic sense in composition and can easily stir emotions.

meaningEn: to sit and look at the computer

sentences.hanzi: 他一整天都坐着看电脑，眼睛有点累了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 yi4 zheng3 tian1 dou1 zuo4 zhe5 kan4 dian4 nao3, yan3 jing1 you3 dian3 lei4 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 하루 종일 앉아서 컴퓨터를 봐서 눈이 좀 피곤해졌다.
sentences.meaningEn: He sat looking at the computer all day, so his eyes became a bit tired.

meaningEn: the group leader reminds again
meaningKo: 조장이 다시 한 번 주의를 주다

sentences.hanzi: 开始前，组长再次提醒大家不要遗漏步骤。
sentences.pinyin: kai1 shi3 qian2, zu3 zhang3 zai4 ci4 ti2 xing3 da4 jia1 bu2 yao4 yi2 lou4 bu4 zhou4.
sentences.meaningKo: 시작 전에 조장은 다시 한 번 모두에게 단계를 빠뜨리지 말라고 주의를 주었다.
sentences.meaningEn: Before starting, the group leader reminded everyone once again not to miss any steps.

meaningEn: not afraid of trouble in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 他做事不怕麻烦，所以细节总是处理得很到位。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 bu4 pa4 ma2 fan2, suo3 yi3 xi4 jie2 zong3 shi4 chu3 li3 de5 hen3 dao4 wei4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 일할 때 번거로움을 두려워하지 않아서 세부를 늘 아주 제대로 처리한다.
sentences.meaningEn: He is not afraid of trouble in doing things, so the details are always handled very thoroughly.

meaningEn: the work process goes smoothly

sentences.hanzi: 前期准备充分，所以这次作业过程很顺利。
sentences.pinyin: qian2 qi1 zhun3 bei4 chong1 fen4, suo3 yi3 zhe4 ci4 zuo4 ye4 guo4 cheng2 hen3 shun4 li4.
sentences.meaningKo: 초기 준비가 충분해서 이번 작업 과정은 매우 순조로웠다.
sentences.meaningEn: The preliminary preparation was sufficient, so this work process went very smoothly.

meaningEn: to sit and wait for the notice to be issued

sentences.hanzi: 大家先坐着等通知下达，不要提前行动。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 xian1 zuo4 zhe5 deng3 tong1 zhi1 xia4 da2, bu2 yao4 ti2 qian2 xing2 dong4.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두 먼저 앉아서 공지가 내려오기를 기다리고 미리 행동하지 마라.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone should sit and wait for the notice to be issued, and not act in advance.

meaningEn: the group leader is responsible for final checking

sentences.hanzi: 最后一关由组长负责把关，大家都比较放心。
sentences.pinyin: zui4 hou4 yi4 guan1 you2 zu3 zhang3 fu4 ze2 ba3 guan1, da4 jia1 dou1 bi3 jiao4 fang4 xin1.
sentences.meaningKo: 마지막 관문은 조장이 최종 점검을 책임져서 모두가 비교적 안심한다.
sentences.meaningEn: The final stage is checked by the group leader, so everyone feels relatively at ease.

meaningEn: to do things with a good rhythm

sentences.hanzi: 他做事有节奏，所以忙起来也不会乱。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 you3 jie2 zou4, suo3 yi3 mang2 qi3 lai2 ye3 bu2 hui4 luan4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 일할 때 리듬이 있어서 바빠져도 흐트러지지 않는다.
sentences.meaningEn: He does things with a good rhythm, so even when busy he does not become chaotic.

meaningEn: adjustment of the work content

sentences.hanzi: 根据反馈，我们对作业内容做了小范围调整。
sentences.pinyin: gen1 ju4 fan3 kui4, wo3 men5 dui4 zuo4 ye4 nei4 rong2 zuo4 le5 xiao3 fan4 wei2 tiao2 zheng3.
sentences.meaningKo: 피드백에 따라 우리는 작업 내용에 소규모 조정을 했다.
sentences.meaningEn: According to the feedback, we made small-scale adjustments to the work content.

meaningEn: to sit and wait for a reply

sentences.hanzi: 与其坐着等回复，不如先把下一步准备好。
sentences.pinyin: yu3 qi2 zuo4 zhe5 deng3 hui2 fu4, bu4 ru2 xian1 ba3 xia4 yi2 bu4 zhun3 bei4 hao3.
sentences.meaningKo: 앉아서 답변을 기다리기보다는 먼저 다음 단계를 준비해 두는 편이 낫다.
sentences.meaningEn: Rather than sitting and waiting for a reply, it is better to prepare the next step first.

meaningEn: the group leader arranges things in advance

sentences.hanzi: 因为组长提前安排好了，所以现场一点也不乱。
sentences.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zu3 zhang3 ti2 qian2 an1 pai2 hao3 le5, suo3 yi3 xian4 chang3 yi4 dian3 ye3 bu4 luan4.
sentences.meaningKo: 조장이 미리 배치를 잘해 두어서 현장은 조금도 어지럽지 않았다.
sentences.meaningEn: Because the group leader arranged everything in advance, the site was not chaotic at all.

meaningEn: to have ideas in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 他做事有想法，所以常常能提出新办法。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 you3 xiang3 fa3, suo3 yi3 chang2 chang2 neng2 ti2 chu1 xin1 ban4 fa3.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 일할 때 자기 생각이 있어서 자주 새로운 방법을 내놓는다.
sentences.meaningEn: He has ideas in doing things, so he can often come up with new methods.

meaningEn: the work time is clearly defined

sentences.hanzi: 只要作业时间明确，大家安排起来就更容易。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 ye4 shi2 jian1 ming2 que4, da4 jia1 an1 pai2 qi3 lai2 jiu4 geng4 rong2 yi4.
sentences.meaningKo: 작업 시간만 명확하면 모두가 일정을 짜기가 더 쉬워진다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the work time is clearly defined, it becomes easier for everyone to make arrangements.

meaningEn: to sit and wait for someone to come

sentences.hanzi: 我先坐着等人来，你去把门打开。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 xian1 zuo4 zhe5 deng3 ren2 lai2, ni3 qu4 ba3 men2 da3 kai1.
sentences.meaningKo: 나는 먼저 앉아서 사람이 오기를 기다릴 테니 너는 가서 문을 열어라.
sentences.meaningEn: I will sit and wait for someone to come; you go open the door.

meaningEn: the group leader explains the situation clearly

sentences.hanzi: 只要把情况讲明，大家就不会再误会了。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 ba3 qing2 kuang4 jiang3 ming2, da4 jia1 jiu4 bu2 hui4 zai4 wu4 hui4 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 상황만 분명히 설명하면 모두가 더는 오해하지 않을 것이다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the situation is explained clearly, everyone will no longer misunderstand.

meaningEn: to be systematic and organized in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 她做事很有条理性，所以整理资料特别快。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 hen3 you3 tiao2 li3 xing4, suo3 yi3 zheng3 li3 zi1 liao4 te4 bie2 kuai4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그녀는 일할 때 체계성과 조리가 있어서 자료 정리가 특히 빠르다.
sentences.meaningEn: She is very systematic and organized in doing things, so she is especially fast at organizing materials.

meaningEn: the task allocation is reasonable

sentences.hanzi: 只要作业分配合理，团队效率就能保持稳定。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 ye4 fen1 pei4 he2 li3, tuan2 dui4 xiao4 lv4 jiu4 neng2 bao3 chi2 wen3 ding4.
sentences.meaningKo: 작업 배분만 합리적이면 팀 효율은 안정적으로 유지될 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the task allocation is reasonable, team efficiency can remain stable.

meaningEn: to sit and write something

sentences.hanzi: 他一个下午都坐着写东西，没有怎么说话。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 yi2 ge4 xia4 wu3 dou1 zuo4 zhe5 xie3 dong1 xi5, mei2 you3 zen3 me5 shuo1 hua4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 오후 내내 앉아서 무언가를 쓰느라 거의 말을 하지 않았다.
sentences.meaningEn: He spent the whole afternoon sitting and writing something, hardly speaking at all.

meaningEn: the group leader's arrangements are clear

sentences.hanzi: 只要组长安排明确，大家执行起来就不会混乱。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zu3 zhang3 an1 pai2 ming2 que4, da4 jia1 zhi2 xing2 qi3 lai2 jiu4 bu2 hui4 hun4 luan4.
sentences.meaningKo: 조장의 배치만 명확하면 모두가 실행할 때 혼란스러워지지 않는다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the group leader’s arrangements are clear, everyone will not become confused when carrying them out.

meaningEn: the work objective is clear

sentences.hanzi: 只要作业目标明确，大家推进起来就更有动力。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 ye4 mu4 biao1 ming2 que4, da4 jia1 tui1 jin4 qi3 lai2 jiu4 geng4 you3 dong4 li4.
sentences.meaningKo: 작업 목표만 명확하면 모두가 추진할 때 훨씬 더 동력이 생긴다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the work objective is clear, everyone will have more motivation when pushing it forward.

meaningEn: after giving an explanation

sentences.hanzi: 他做出解释后，大家的情绪才慢慢稳定下来。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 chu1 jie3 shi4 hou4, da4 jia1 de5 qing2 xu4 cai2 man4 man4 wen3 ding4 xia4 lai2.
sentences.meaningKo: 그가 해명을 한 뒤에야 모두의 감정이 천천히 안정되었다.
sentences.meaningEn: Only after he gave an explanation did everyone’s emotions gradually settle down.

meaningEn: team members help each other

sentences.hanzi: 只要组员互相帮助，很多困难都能顺利解决。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zu3 yuan2 hu4 xiang1 bang1 zhu4, hen3 duo1 kun4 nan2 dou1 neng2 shun4 li4 jie3 jue2.
sentences.meaningKo: 조원들이 서로 돕기만 하면 많은 어려움도 순조롭게 해결할 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as team members help each other, many difficulties can be resolved smoothly.

meaningEn: to sit in the back

sentences.hanzi: 坐在后边的人可能看得不太清楚。
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 zai4 hou4 bian1 de5 ren2 ke3 neng2 kan4 de5 bu2 tai4 qing1 chu3.
sentences.meaningKo: 뒤쪽에 앉은 사람들은 잘 보이지 않을 수도 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: People sitting in the back may not be able to see very clearly.

meaningEn: to have a keen sense for composition

sentences.hanzi: 他对旋律变化特别敏感，作曲感觉很敏锐。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 dui4 xuan2 lv4 bian4 hua4 te4 bie2 min3 gan3, zuo4 qu3 gan3 jue2 hen3 min3 rui4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 선율 변화에 특히 민감해서 작곡 감각이 매우 예민하다.
sentences.meaningEn: He is especially sensitive to melodic changes and has a very keen sense for composition.

meaningEn: to pay attention to sequence in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 做事要讲次序，不能想到哪一步就做哪一步。
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 shi4 yao4 jiang3 ci4 xu4, bu4 neng2 xiang3 dao4 na3 yi2 bu4 jiu4 zuo4 na3 yi2 bu4.
sentences.meaningKo: 일할 때는 순서를 중시해야지 생각나는 대로 해서는 안 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: When doing things, one must pay attention to sequence and cannot simply do whatever step comes to mind.

meaningEn: the scope of the assignment is clear

sentences.hanzi: 只要作业范围清楚，准备起来就不会走偏。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 ye4 fan4 wei2 qing1 chu3, zhun3 bei4 qi3 lai2 jiu4 bu2 hui4 zou3 pian1.
sentences.meaningKo: 과제 범위만 분명하면 준비할 때 빗나가지 않는다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the scope of the assignment is clear, the preparation will not go off track.

meaningEn: to sit and wait/listen for news

sentences.hanzi: 大家都坐着听消息，谁也不敢先下结论。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 dou1 zuo4 zhe5 ting1 xiao1 xi5, shui2 ye3 bu4 gan3 xian1 xia4 jie2 lun4.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두가 앉아서 소식을 들으며 누구도 먼저 결론을 내리지 못했다.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone sat waiting for the news, and no one dared to draw a conclusion first.

meaningEn: the group leader makes unified arrangements/deployment

sentences.hanzi: 正式开始前，先由组长统一部署后续安排。
sentences.pinyin: zheng4 shi4 kai1 shi3 qian2, xian1 you2 zu3 zhang3 tong3 yi1 bu4 shu3 hou4 xu4 an1 pai2.
sentences.meaningKo: 정식으로 시작하기 전에 먼저 조장이 후속 배치를 통일적으로 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: Before formally starting, the group leader first makes unified arrangements for the follow-up work.

meaningEn: to be patient in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 她做事很有耐性，复杂的工作也能慢慢做好。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 hen3 you3 nai4 xing4, fu4 za2 de5 gong1 zuo4 ye3 neng2 man4 man4 zuo4 hao3.
sentences.meaningKo: 그녀는 일할 때 인내심이 있어서 복잡한 일도 천천히 잘 해낼 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: She is very patient in doing things and can slowly do even complex work well.

meaningEn: the answering requirements are clear

sentences.hanzi: 只要作答要求明确，学生就不会太慌张。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 da2 yao1 qiu2 ming2 que4, xue2 sheng1 jiu4 bu2 hui4 tai4 huang1 zhang1.
sentences.meaningKo: 답안 작성 요구 사항만 명확하면 학생들은 그리 당황하지 않는다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the answering requirements are clear, students will not become too flustered.

meaningEn: the composition technique is mature

sentences.hanzi: 经过多年训练，他的作曲技巧已经很成熟了。
sentences.pinyin: jing1 guo4 duo1 nian2 xun4 lian4, ta1 de5 zuo4 qu3 ji4 qiao3 yi3 jing1 hen3 cheng2 shu2 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 여러 해의 훈련을 거쳐 그의 작곡 기법은 이미 매우 성숙해졌다.
sentences.meaningEn: After many years of training, his composition technique has become very mature.

meaningEn: to sit and read materials

sentences.hanzi: 他下午一直坐着看材料，几乎没怎么休息。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xia4 wu3 yi4 zhi2 zuo4 zhe5 kan4 cai2 liao4, ji1 hu1 mei2 zen3 me5 xiu1 xi5.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 오후 내내 앉아서 자료를 보느라 거의 쉬지 못했다.
sentences.meaningEn: He spent the whole afternoon sitting and reading materials, hardly taking any rest.

meaningEn: the group leader makes the final decision

sentences.hanzi: 讨论了这么久，还是要由组长做最后决定。
sentences.pinyin: tao3 lun4 le5 zhe4 me5 jiu3, hai2 shi4 yao4 you2 zu3 zhang3 zuo4 zui4 hou4 jue2 ding4.
sentences.meaningKo: 이렇게 오래 토론했지만 결국은 조장이 최종 결정을 내려야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: After discussing for so long, the final decision still has to be made by the group leader.

meaningEn: to have a sense of proportion in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 和人合作时，做事得讲分寸感。
sentences.pinyin: he2 ren2 he2 zuo4 shi2, zuo4 shi4 dei3 jiang3 fen4 cun4 gan3.
sentences.meaningKo: 남과 협력할 때는 일을 하면서 적절한 선을 알아야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: When cooperating with others, one must have a sense of proportion in doing things.

meaningEn: the work arrangement is detailed

sentences.hanzi: 这次作业安排很详细，大家照着执行就可以。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ci4 zuo4 ye4 an1 pai2 hen3 xiang2 xi4, da4 jia1 zhao4 zhe5 zhi2 xing2 jiu4 ke3 yi3.
sentences.meaningKo: 이번 작업 배치는 매우 상세하니 모두 그대로 실행하면 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: The work arrangement this time is very detailed, so everyone only needs to carry it out accordingly.

meaningEn: to sit and wait until the arrangements are finished

sentences.hanzi: 大家先坐着等安排完，再分头行动。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 xian1 zuo4 zhe5 deng3 an1 pai2 wan2, zai4 fen1 tou2 xing2 dong4.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두 먼저 앉아서 배치가 끝나기를 기다린 뒤에 나누어 행동하자.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone should first sit and wait until the arrangements are finished, and then act separately.

meaningEn: the group leader is responsible for overall coordination

sentences.hanzi: 整个流程由组长负责统筹，其他人按分工执行。
sentences.pinyin: zheng3 ge4 liu2 cheng2 you2 zu3 zhang3 fu4 ze2 tong3 chou2, qi2 ta1 ren2 an4 fen1 gong1 zhi2 xing2.
sentences.meaningKo: 전체 절차는 조장이 총괄을 책임지고 다른 사람들은 역할 분담에 따라 실행한다.
sentences.meaningEn: The entire process is coordinated overall by the group leader, while the others execute according to the division of labor.

meaningEn: to have a sense of proportion in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 他说话做事都有分寸感，所以大家都愿意和他合作。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 hua4 zuo4 shi4 dou1 you3 fen4 cun4 gan3, suo3 yi3 da4 jia1 dou1 yuan4 yi4 he2 ta1 he2 zuo4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 말과 일을 할 때 모두 분별이 있어서 모두가 그와 협력하기를 원한다.
sentences.meaningEn: He has a good sense of proportion in both speech and action, so everyone is willing to cooperate with him.

meaningEn: the difficulty of the assignment increases

sentences.hanzi: 到了后半段，作业难度明显增加了。
sentences.pinyin: dao4 le5 hou4 ban4 duan4, zuo4 ye4 nan2 du4 ming2 xian3 zeng1 jia1 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 후반부에 이르자 과제 난도가 눈에 띄게 높아졌다.
sentences.meaningEn: By the latter half, the difficulty of the assignment had increased noticeably.

meaningEn: to sit and listen to the explanation

sentences.hanzi: 大家先坐着听讲解，弄懂以后再自己做。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 xian1 zuo4 zhe5 ting1 jiang3 jie3, nong4 dong3 yi3 hou4 zai4 zi4 ji3 zuo4.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두 먼저 앉아서 해설을 듣고 이해한 뒤에 스스로 해 보아라.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone should first sit and listen to the explanation, and then do it on their own after understanding it.

meaningEn: the group leader explains the task clearly

sentences.hanzi: 只要组长把任务说清，大家行动起来就不会乱。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zu3 zhang3 ba3 ren4 wu5 shuo1 qing1, da4 jia1 xing2 dong4 qi3 lai2 jiu4 bu2 hui4 luan4.
sentences.meaningKo: 조장이 임무를 분명히 설명하기만 하면 모두가 행동할 때 혼란스럽지 않다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the group leader explains the task clearly, everyone will not become chaotic when taking action.

meaningEn: to be planned and systematic in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 她做事很有计划性，所以时间利用得特别好。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 hen3 you3 ji4 hua4 xing4, suo3 yi3 shi2 jian1 li4 yong4 de5 te4 bie2 hao3.
sentences.meaningKo: 그녀는 일할 때 계획성이 있어서 시간을 특히 잘 활용한다.
sentences.meaningEn: She is very planned in doing things, so she uses time especially well.

meaningEn: changes in assignment requirements

sentences.hanzi: 这次的作业要求变化比较大，大家要重新确认。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ci4 de5 zuo4 ye4 yao1 qiu2 bian4 hua4 bi3 jiao4 da4, da4 jia1 yao4 chong2 xin1 que4 ren4.
sentences.meaningKo: 이번 과제 요구 사항 변화는 비교적 크니 모두 다시 확인해야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: The changes in the assignment requirements this time are relatively large, so everyone needs to confirm them again.

meaningEn: to sit and wait for a decision

sentences.hanzi: 与其坐着等决定，不如先准备几个方案。
sentences.pinyin: yu3 qi2 zuo4 zhe5 deng3 jue2 ding4, bu4 ru2 xian1 zhun3 bei4 ji3 ge4 fang1 an4.
sentences.meaningKo: 앉아서 결정을 기다리기보다는 먼저 몇 가지 방안을 준비해 두는 편이 낫다.
sentences.meaningEn: Rather than sitting and waiting for a decision, it is better to prepare several plans first.

meaningEn: the group leader gives a unified reply

sentences.hanzi: 外界的问题暂时由组长统一回复。
sentences.pinyin: wai4 jie4 de5 wen4 ti2 zan4 shi2 you2 zu3 zhang3 tong3 yi1 hui2 fu4.
sentences.meaningKo: 외부의 질문에는 당분간 조장이 통일적으로 답변한다.
sentences.meaningEn: For the time being, questions from outside will be answered in a unified way by the group leader.

meaningEn: to be responsible in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 她做事很有责任心，所以交给她的事情都很稳妥。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 hen3 you3 ze2 ren4 xin1, suo3 yi3 jiao1 gei3 ta1 de5 shi4 qing2 dou1 hen3 wen3 tuo3.
sentences.meaningKo: 그녀는 일할 때 책임감이 있어서 그녀에게 맡긴 일은 모두 매우 안정적이다.
sentences.meaningEn: She is very responsible in doing things, so everything entrusted to her is handled very reliably.

meaningEn: changes in work arrangement

sentences.hanzi: 今天的作业安排变化比较多，大家注意确认。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 tian1 de5 zuo4 ye4 an1 pai2 bian4 hua4 bi3 jiao4 duo1, da4 jia1 zhu4 yi4 que4 ren4.
sentences.meaningKo: 오늘의 작업 배치 변화가 비교적 많으니 모두 확인에 주의해라.
sentences.meaningEn: There are quite a lot of changes in today’s work arrangement, so everyone should pay attention to confirming them.

meaningEn: to sit and listen until the arrangements are completely finished

sentences.hanzi: 大家先坐着把安排听完毕，再开始分组行动。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 xian1 zuo4 zhe5 ba3 an1 pai2 ting1 wan2 bi4, zai4 kai1 shi3 fen1 zu3 xing2 dong4.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두 먼저 앉아서 배치를 끝까지 다 듣고 그다음 조를 나누어 행동을 시작하자.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone should first sit and listen until all the arrangements are completely finished, and then begin acting in groups.

meaningEn: the group leader arranged things very thoroughly

sentences.hanzi: 这次活动能顺利进行，是因为组长安排得很周到。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ci4 huo2 dong4 neng2 shun4 li4 jin4 xing2, shi4 yin1 wei4 zu3 zhang3 an1 pai2 de5 hen3 zhou1 dao4.
sentences.meaningKo: 이번 활동이 순조롭게 진행될 수 있었던 것은 조장이 매우 주도면밀하게 배치했기 때문이다.
sentences.meaningEn: The reason this activity could proceed smoothly is that the group leader arranged everything very thoroughly.

meaningEn: the assignment requirements are stable

sentences.hanzi: 这阶段作业要求比较稳定，大家可以安心推进。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 jie1 duan4 zuo4 ye4 yao1 qiu2 bi3 jiao4 wen3 ding4, da4 jia1 ke3 yi3 an1 xin1 tui1 jin4.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 단계의 과제 요구 사항은 비교적 안정적이어서 모두 안심하고 추진할 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: At this stage, the assignment requirements are relatively stable, so everyone can proceed with peace of mind.

meaningEn: to give supplementary explanation

sentences.hanzi: 发现大家还有疑问后，他又做出了补充说明。
sentences.pinyin: fa1 xian4 da4 jia1 hai2 you3 yi2 wen4 hou4, ta1 you4 zuo4 chu1 le5 bu3 chong1 shuo1 ming2.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두에게 아직 의문이 있다는 것을 알고 그는 다시 보충 설명을 했다.
sentences.meaningEn: After noticing that everyone still had questions, he gave some supplementary explanation.

meaningEn: team members cooperate with each other

sentences.hanzi: 只要组员互相配合，很多任务都会完成得更快。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zu3 yuan2 hu4 xiang1 pei4 he2, hen3 duo1 ren4 wu5 dou1 hui4 wan2 cheng2 de5 geng4 kuai4.
sentences.meaningKo: 조원들이 서로 협력하기만 하면 많은 임무가 더 빨리 완수된다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the team members cooperate with each other, many tasks will be completed faster.

meaningEn: to sit by the door

sentences.hanzi: 他喜欢坐在门边，这样进出都方便一些。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xi3 huan1 zuo4 zai4 men2 bian1, zhe4 yang4 jin4 chu1 dou1 fang1 bian4 yi4 xie1.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 문가에 앉는 것을 좋아하는데 그러면 드나들기가 좀 더 편하다.
sentences.meaningEn: He likes to sit by the door, because that makes coming and going a bit more convenient.

meaningEn: the compositional approach is clear

sentences.hanzi: 只要作曲思路明确，后面的写作就会顺很多。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 qu3 si1 lu4 ming2 que4, hou4 mian4 de5 xie3 zuo4 jiu4 hui4 shun4 hen3 duo1.
sentences.meaningKo: 작곡 구상만 명확하면 뒤의 곡 쓰기는 훨씬 순조로워진다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the compositional approach is clear, the later writing process becomes much smoother.

meaningEn: to emphasize methodology in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 复杂项目更要做事讲方法论，不能只靠经验。
sentences.pinyin: fu4 za2 xiang4 mu4 geng4 yao4 zuo4 shi4 jiang3 fang1 fa3 lun4, bu4 neng2 zhi3 kao4 jing1 yan4.
sentences.meaningKo: 복잡한 프로젝트일수록 일을 할 때 방법론을 중시해야 하며 경험에만 기대서는 안 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: The more complex the project, the more one must emphasize methodology in doing things and not rely only on experience.

meaningEn: the work process is clear

sentences.hanzi: 只要作业过程清楚，交接起来就不会有太多问题。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 ye4 guo4 cheng2 qing1 chu3, jiao1 jie1 qi3 lai2 jiu4 bu2 hui4 you3 tai4 duo1 wen4 ti2.
sentences.meaningKo: 작업 과정만 분명하면 인수인계할 때 큰 문제가 생기지 않는다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the work process is clear, there will not be too many problems during handover.

meaningEn: to sit and wait for arrangement notice

sentences.hanzi: 大家先坐着等安排通知，不要自己先行动。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 xian1 zuo4 zhe5 deng3 an1 pai2 tong1 zhi1, bu2 yao4 zi4 ji3 xian1 xing2 dong4.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두 먼저 앉아서 배치 공지를 기다리고 스스로 먼저 움직이지 마라.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone should first sit and wait for the arrangement notice and not act on their own beforehand.

meaningEn: the group leader assigns tasks in a unified way

sentences.hanzi: 开会以后，由组长统一安排任务最省时间。
sentences.pinyin: kai1 hui4 yi3 hou4, you2 zu3 zhang3 tong3 yi1 an1 pai2 ren4 wu5 zui4 sheng3 shi2 jian1.
sentences.meaningKo: 회의 뒤에는 조장이 통일적으로 임무를 배치하는 것이 가장 시간을 아낀다.
sentences.meaningEn: After the meeting, having the group leader assign tasks in a unified way saves the most time.

meaningEn: to do things in an orderly, methodical way

sentences.hanzi: 他做事有章法，所以再复杂的情况也能慢慢理顺。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 you3 zhang1 fa3, suo3 yi3 zai4 fu4 za2 de5 qing2 kuang4 ye3 neng2 man4 man4 li3 shun4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 일을 규칙과 체계 있게 해서 아무리 복잡한 상황도 차근차근 정리해 낸다.
sentences.meaningEn: He does things in an orderly, methodical way, so even very complex situations can gradually be sorted out.

meaningEn: the answering format is unified

sentences.hanzi: 只要作答方式统一，后面统计起来就方便了。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 da2 fang1 shi4 tong3 yi1, hou4 mian4 tong3 ji4 qi3 lai2 jiu4 fang1 bian4 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 답안 작성 방식만 통일되어 있으면 나중에 통계 내기가 편해진다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the answering format is unified, later statistics become easier to compile.

meaningEn: the compositional style is mature

sentences.hanzi: 经过多年积累，他的作曲风格已经比较成熟。
sentences.pinyin: jing1 guo4 duo1 nian2 ji1 lei3, ta1 de5 zuo4 qu3 feng1 ge2 yi3 jing1 bi3 jiao4 cheng2 shu2.
sentences.meaningKo: 여러 해의 축적을 거쳐 그의 작곡 스타일은 이미 비교적 성숙해졌다.
sentences.meaningEn: After years of accumulation, his compositional style has become relatively mature.

meaningEn: to sit and listen to the result

sentences.hanzi: 大家都安静地坐着听结果，谁也没有插话。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 dou1 an1 jing4 di5 zuo4 zhe5 ting1 jie2 guo3, shui2 ye3 mei2 you3 cha1 hua4.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두가 조용히 앉아서 결과를 들었고 누구도 말을 끼어들지 않았다.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone sat quietly listening to the result, and no one interrupted.

meaningEn: the group leader arranges the process

sentences.hanzi: 为了不耽误时间，先由组长安排流程。
sentences.pinyin: wei4 le5 bu4 dan1 wu4 shi2 jian1, xian1 you2 zu3 zhang3 an1 pai2 liu2 cheng2.
sentences.meaningKo: 시간을 지체하지 않기 위해 먼저 조장이 절차를 배치한다.
sentences.meaningEn: To avoid wasting time, the process is first arranged by the group leader.

meaningEn: to have judgment in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 他做事有判断力，所以关键时候总能拿定主意。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 you3 pan4 duan4 li4, suo3 yi3 guan1 jian4 shi2 hou4 zong3 neng2 na2 ding4 zhu3 yi4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 일할 때 판단력이 있어서 중요한 순간마다 늘 결단을 내릴 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: He has judgment in doing things, so at critical moments he can always make up his mind.

meaningEn: adjustment of work priorities

sentences.hanzi: 根据最新进展，我们对作业重点做了调整。
sentences.pinyin: gen1 ju4 zui4 xin1 jin4 zhan3, wo3 men5 dui4 zuo4 ye4 zhong4 dian3 zuo4 le5 tiao2 zheng3.
sentences.meaningKo: 최신 진전에 따라 우리는 작업 중점을 조정했다.
sentences.meaningEn: According to the latest progress, we adjusted the work priorities.

meaningEn: to sit and wait for the result to come out

sentences.hanzi: 与其坐着等结果出来，不如先把后续方案准备好。
sentences.pinyin: yu3 qi2 zuo4 zhe5 deng3 jie2 guo3 chu1 lai2, bu4 ru2 xian1 ba3 hou4 xu4 fang1 an4 zhun3 bei4 hao3.
sentences.meaningKo: 앉아서 결과가 나오기를 기다리기보다는 먼저 후속 방안을 준비해 두는 편이 낫다.
sentences.meaningEn: Rather than sitting and waiting for the result to come out, it is better to prepare the follow-up plan first.

meaningEn: the group leader conducts a unified inspection

sentences.hanzi: 提交之前，由组长统一检查一遍最稳妥。
sentences.pinyin: ti2 jiao1 zhi1 qian2, you2 zu3 zhang3 tong3 yi1 jian3 cha2 yi2 bian4 zui4 wen3 tuo3.
sentences.meaningKo: 제출 전에 조장이 한 번 통일적으로 점검하는 것이 가장 안전하다.
sentences.meaningEn: Before submission, it is safest for the group leader to conduct one unified inspection.

meaningEn: to have execution ability in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 光有想法还不够，做事还得有执行力。
sentences.pinyin: guang1 you3 xiang3 fa3 hai2 bu4 gou4, zuo4 shi4 hai2 dei3 you3 zhi2 xing2 li4.
sentences.meaningKo: 생각만 있어서는 부족하고 일을 할 때는 실행력도 있어야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: Having ideas alone is not enough; one must also have execution ability in doing things.

meaningEn: the work pace is stable

sentences.hanzi: 只要作业节奏稳定，后面的效率就容易保持。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 ye4 jie2 zou4 wen3 ding4, hou4 mian4 de5 xiao4 lv4 jiu4 rong2 yi4 bao3 chi2.
sentences.meaningKo: 작업 리듬만 안정적이면 이후 효율을 유지하기 쉬워진다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the work pace is stable, later efficiency is easier to maintain.

meaningEn: to sit and wait for the teacher's explanation

sentences.hanzi: 大家先坐着等老师说明清楚，再开始操作。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 xian1 zuo4 zhe5 deng3 lao3 shi1 shuo1 ming2 qing1 chu3, zai4 kai1 shi3 cao1 zuo4.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두 먼저 앉아서 선생님의 설명이 분명해지기를 기다린 뒤 조작을 시작하자.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone should first sit and wait for the teacher’s explanation to become clear, and then begin operating.

meaningEn: the group leader explains the situation clearly

sentences.hanzi: 只要组长把情况讲清，大家就知道下一步怎么做。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zu3 zhang3 ba3 qing2 kuang4 jiang3 qing1, da4 jia1 jiu4 zhi1 dao4 xia4 yi2 bu4 zen3 me5 zuo4.
sentences.meaningKo: 조장이 상황을 분명히 말하기만 하면 모두 다음에 무엇을 해야 하는지 알게 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the group leader explains the situation clearly, everyone will know what to do next.

meaningEn: to produce effective results in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 方法对了，做事自然就会有效果。
sentences.pinyin: fang1 fa3 dui4 le5, zuo4 shi4 zi4 ran2 jiu4 hui4 you3 xiao4 guo3.
sentences.meaningKo: 방법이 맞으면 일을 할 때 자연히 효과가 난다.
sentences.meaningEn: If the method is right, doing things will naturally produce effective results.

meaningEn: the work content is complete

sentences.hanzi: 只要作业内容完整，汇报的时候就更有底气。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 ye4 nei4 rong2 wan2 zheng3, hui4 bao4 de5 shi2 hou4 jiu4 geng4 you3 di3 qi4.
sentences.meaningKo: 작업 내용만 완전하면 보고할 때 훨씬 더 자신감이 생긴다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the work content is complete, one will feel more confident when reporting.

meaningEn: to sit and wait for the next step

sentences.hanzi: 先别急，大家坐着等下一步安排。
sentences.pinyin: xian1 bie2 ji2, da4 jia1 zuo4 zhe5 deng3 xia4 yi2 bu4 an1 pai2.
sentences.meaningKo: 먼저 서두르지 말고 모두 앉아서 다음 단계 배치를 기다려라.
sentences.meaningEn: Do not rush; everyone should sit and wait for the next-step arrangements.

meaningEn: the group leader arranges coordination work

sentences.hanzi: 涉及多个环节时，要由组长安排协调。
sentences.pinyin: she4 ji2 duo1 ge4 huan2 jie2 shi2, yao4 you2 zu3 zhang3 an1 pai2 xie2 tiao2.
sentences.meaningKo: 여러 단계가 관련될 때는 조장이 조정 업무를 배치해야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: When multiple links are involved, the group leader should arrange the coordination work.

meaningEn: to have a clear thread/clue in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 只要先理清重点，做事就会慢慢有头绪。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 xian1 li3 qing1 zhong4 dian3, zuo4 shi4 jiu4 hui4 man4 man4 you3 tou2 xu4.
sentences.meaningKo: 먼저 핵심을 정리하기만 하면 일을 할 때 점차 가닥이 잡힌다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as you sort out the key points first, things will gradually start to make sense.

meaningEn: the work situation is clear

sentences.hanzi: 只要作业情况明确，后面的安排就更容易做。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 ye4 qing2 kuang4 ming2 que4, hou4 mian4 de5 an1 pai2 jiu4 geng4 rong2 yi4 zuo4.
sentences.meaningKo: 작업 상황만 명확하면 이후 배치를 하기가 더 쉬워진다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the work situation is clear, it becomes easier to make the later arrangements.

meaningEn: to sit and listen to the arrangement results

sentences.hanzi: 大家先坐着听安排结果，再决定各自要做什么。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 xian1 zuo4 zhe5 ting1 an1 pai2 jie2 guo3, zai4 jue2 ding4 ge4 zi4 yao4 zuo4 shen2 me5.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두 먼저 앉아서 배치 결과를 듣고 그다음 각자 무엇을 할지 결정해라.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone should first sit and listen to the arrangement results, and then decide what each person should do.

meaningEn: the group leader's arrangements are thorough and meticulous

sentences.hanzi: 这次任务之所以顺利，是因为组长安排周密。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ci4 ren4 wu5 zhi1 suo3 yi3 shun4 li4, shi4 yin1 wei4 zu3 zhang3 an1 pai2 zhou1 mi4.
sentences.meaningKo: 이번 임무가 순조로웠던 것은 조장의 배치가 주도면밀했기 때문이다.
sentences.meaningEn: The reason this task went smoothly is that the group leader’s arrangements were thorough and meticulous.
